## 经济新闻日报（2026-07-14）

中东地缘政治骤然升级，成为今日全球市场最核心的变量。美国连续三晚对伊朗发动空袭，特朗普宣布对霍尔木兹海峡过往船舶征收20%的通行费并重启伊朗封锁，布伦特原油单日飙升5%，国内原油期货主力合约涨幅扩大至9%。与此同时，中国6月出口数据超预期增长（以美元计为2021年以来最快），AI相关电子元件、电脑零部件出口两位数增长，但A股科创50指数反而下跌超3%，显示市场对地缘风险的定价已压倒贸易基本面。欧洲方面，ECB官员表态关注增长韧性，而住房流动性陷阱正在演变为劳动力市场问题。以下是主要动态：

- **油价暴涨与霍尔木兹海峡危机**：特朗普提出对霍尔木兹海峡过往船舶征收20%的通行费，并重启伊朗封锁。美国已完成第三晚对伊朗的空袭，伊朗则袭击海湾邻国美军设施。布伦特原油上涨5%，国内原油期货涨9%，韩国交易所甚至触发程序化卖盘熔断。[油价上涨报道](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-hormuz-trump-toll-iran.html) | [特朗普计划](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/13/trump-iran-hormuz-strait-charge-reimburse.html) | [美伊冲突](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/us-iran-hormuz-strikes-oil-toll.html)

- **中国6月出口强劲，AI驱动贸易增长**：海关总署数据显示，上半年电子元件、电脑零部件等出口均为两位数增长，合计拉动出口6.9个百分点；进口历史同期首次突破10万亿元，增速高于出口8.7个百分点。CNBC报道中国对美出口6月增长约14%，进口增长26%。[CNBC报道](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/china-june-trade-data-exports-imports.html) | [海关发布会](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTFBUZWZaZW9lcTQyVlc5cG5WX2M0Tk1vQUV1c2xXVUFvUUx0aVJTWkh1S1FZclY2MkVCVjVQS0NMSFN4MFBZX0QySXlHSVZjbnVsYUtfVA)

- **美股与全球市场联动**：受地缘风险影响，美股科技股承压，亚洲市场科技股拖累。Paramount-Warner Bros合并遭加州等12州起诉；日本国债收益率攀升，市场重新关注日本债券投资价值。[Paramount诉讼](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/13/business/paramount-warner-bros-lawsuit.html) | [日本债券市场](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/japan-bond-jgb-yields-.html)

- **欧洲经济与央行动向**：ECB官员Cipollone和Schnabel分别发表讲话，强调欧洲增长与韧性。欧洲并购活动展现韧性，但住房流动性陷阱成为劳动力市场难题；波兰经济越来越依赖乌克兰工人。[ECB讲话](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/inter/date/2026/html/ecb.in260713~d928475792.en.html) | [欧洲M&A韧性](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPOTZ5MEM1LVVaYUxERjhlTEpETWRDVHpmLVJKUlhPbDliZEFoZHl5NTh6dm1EVTRDRHMyWkpiTzd2LW1RR2EwdkRuOVU3aVJEeHlqQkNOVWlING5iSlItaVhQUXJoS3hpVzJtaHA2d1NfejV3YjIwd1k5Um01YjljeDZMdkNBWEYw)

- **香港楼市复苏与银行竞争**：香港银行按揭现金回赠升至两年多新高，部分达1.4%，反映银行争夺购房者。恒生指数微涨至24,213点，但内地股市走弱。[香港银行回赠](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3360407/hong-kong-banks-sweeten-mortgage-rebates-competition-heats-amid-property-rebound) | [恒生指数](https://news.google.)

- **中国商业航天IPO浪潮**：北京推动至少15家商业航天公司上市，试图打破SpaceX的发射垄断，采用“狼群”策略。[中国商业航天IPO](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3360351/new-space-race-how-china-plans-break-spacexs-launch-monopoly-ipo-push)

**后续观察**：霍尔木兹海峡的通行费政策若落地，将根本性改变全球能源贸易成本结构，油价可能持续高位震荡。中国出口数据的亮眼能否在A股市场转化为做多动能，取决于市场是否认为地缘冲突的冲击可控。欧洲央行下一步利率行动与住房市场放缓的交互影响值得关注。本周能源、军工、航天板块或成为全球资金博弈焦点。
economy.en:
Markets opened the week under the shadow of escalating U.S.-Iran hostilities, with oil prices surging above $90 a barrel after President Trump announced a 20% toll on all cargo transiting the Strait of Hormuz and resumed a full blockade of Iranian shipping. The geopolitical shockwave rippled across asset classes, sending Asian tech stocks lower and triggering a circuit breaker in South Korea, while U.S. equity futures slipped. Meanwhile, China’s June trade data provided a counter-narrative: exports jumped at the fastest pace since 2021, fueled by AI-related electronics and a pre-tariff rush, and imports topped 10 trillion yuan for the first half – a record. In Europe, ECB officials stressed resilience, but housing mobility constraints are emerging as a labour market drag. Below are the key developments that shaped the economic landscape over the past 24 hours.

- **[Oil surges as U.S. completes third night of strikes and Trump unveils 20% Hormuz toll](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-hormuz-trump-toll-iran.html)** – Brent crude rose 5% on Monday and another 2% on Tuesday after the U.S. launched fresh strikes and Trump’s plan to charge a 20% fee on Hormuz cargo threatened global supply. The blockade directly endorses the risk of a multi-year oil spike, hitting shipping costs but also raising fears of a prolonged Middle East conflict.
- **[China exports jump 14% to U.S. in June, overall export growth fastest since 2021](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/china-june-trade-data-exports-imports.html)** – AI boom and tariff front-loading powered a sharp rebound, with 26% import growth from the U.S. The data suggests global demand remains robust despite trade friction, though the import surge points to domestic re-stocking and resilient consumer spending.
- **[Hong Kong property market rebounds as banks raise mortgage rebates to 1.4%](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3360407/hong-kong-banks-sweeten-mortgage-rebates-competition-heats-amid-property-rebound)** – Cash rebates hit two-year highs as lenders compete for homebuyers, signaling a tentative recovery in one of Asia’s most watched property markets. The rebound is still fragile given uncertainty over U.S. rate hikes.
- **[European M&A defies ECB rate hike, proving more resilient than global peers](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPOTZ5MEM1LVVaYUxERjhlTEpETWRDVHpmLVJKUlhPbDliZEFoZHl5NTh6dm1EVTRDRHMyWkpiTzd2LW1RR2EwdkRuOVU3aVJEeHlqQkNOVWlING5iSlItaVhQUXJoS3hpVzJtaHA2d1NfejV3YjIwd1k5Um01YjljeDZMdkNBWEYw)** – Despite tighter monetary policy, European dealmaking is holding up, particularly in defense and space sectors. ECB’s Schnabel called for growth and resilience, hinting at structural reforms.
- **[Asian tech stocks drag as oil shock and geopolitics weigh on sentiment](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxOdkQ2QUJhVW13U2tHOFNDa1lmVHAzRzdaUVlmcXlQbEZyaC1vOXhfUmFsaWplSjhRajR3bmlZc3RvdEw2dDg2VGRHblBrRGVkY0tSSmhXTVF3VC1zQ2tYeXhVR0JRS241TjNwU053cFJubTloZHdZbTdCUHFlSmNGVC1PVTFjTEdDZ3NPVjNmd08zWmRQbTJOTQ)** – The Shanghai STAR 50 fell 3% and South Korea triggered a program-trading circuit breaker as tech-heavy indices sold off. Chip stocks like CXMT (soon to IPO) saw interest but broader risk-off dominated.
- **[Legal challenge threatens $110bn Paramount-Warner Bros merger](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/13/business/paramount-warner-bros-lawsuit.html)** – California and 11 other states filed an antitrust suit, arguing the deal would hurt movie theaters and lead to job losses. The lawsuit adds uncertainty to an already fragile media landscape.

**Watch next:** The oil price trajectory remains the dominant near-term risk. If Brent holds above $90, central banks may delay rate cuts. Chinese trade data will be dissected for signs of decoupling, while European PMI prints later this week will test the narrative of resilience. Any diplomatic breakthrough in the Gulf could trigger a sharp reversal. Markit flash PMIs and U.S. retail sales are the next data landmarks.

society.zh:
今日社会新闻呈现多焦点并行：国际方面，美伊冲突在霍尔木兹海峡再度升级，导致油价攀升；欧洲西班牙山火致家庭悲剧，匈牙利政局突变；亚洲曼谷酒吧火灾死伤惨重，日本冲绳美军机坠毁创伤未愈。中国方面，AI全球治理大会成为焦点，习近平将出席；校园安全立法推进。知乎社区热议人工客服消失与院士亲述技术突破。整体来看，地缘冲突、灾害安全与科技治理交织，需关注连锁影响。

- **美伊战火重燃**：美国在特朗普宣布封锁霍尔木兹海峡后对伊朗发动新攻击，伊朗称基什、格什姆等地发生爆炸，布伦特原油逼近85美元（[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/7/14/iran-war-live-us-launches-more-attacks-trump-orders-blockade-in-hormuz?traffic_source=rss)）。上月停火协议破裂，市场恐慌加剧。
- **曼谷酒吧火灾28死**：曼谷乍都乍区酒吧凌晨起火，顾客穿火逃生，至少28死25重伤。幸存者描述“无路可逃”，爆炸将他抛出（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c24yev53q06o)）。安全执法漏洞再引反思。
- **悉尼托儿所性侵案**：男子Hamish Tait被控16年内虐待136名儿童，涉及5家托儿所，身份首次公开（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5yzy0lpello)）。澳大利亚社会震惊。
- **日本冲绳美军机坠毁创伤**：日本时报回顾一架美军喷气机坠入冲绳学校事件，强调当地民众持久心理创伤（[Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQc2hNYmZKZUE1TzB5d1U1bVB3TmFQTnZfNzlZdjRQOFM5MEtESExKNnppaE1sX3p0bHo0OHB0eUJjMXBzUWtrMEVac1Z2MUNpM0FNM2xLbWFYcXhsS0lTdTNnT3JVYVdFWWdkQi1QM3dWcHpMQWFrcnlIYXNaaVdVeW1UZ3E4NndU)）。基地问题持续敏感。
- **中国AI全球治理大会**：习近平将出席2026世界人工智能大会并发表主旨讲话，国际社会期待中国为AI治理注入动力（[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE53eHhuR2llS3FTS3JUSVd0cUY4b0xiVVFlN3VxMmdld3BQdXQxdkU3bVhIaUhvTEN0YUtKcERRODRDaExzQk9HRzFqU3NlSFRwb3BlbkZsYV9kV0F2NXd0MEYtWk5FMFRjMEdVSFRGY2pKQlhNU1ZjNjZ2UG82VzA)）。同时新华社评论呼吁AI服务全球福祉。
- **知乎热议“消失的人工客服”**：一篇风闻文章指出用户因找不到人工客服而“走投无路”，引发对自动化服务边界讨论（[风闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE15NGdoM0Rjc0lsSHpReXo0QU5UZmJfNXJoSHNiOTJCSTZkT2ozMXhnMjR2TldhbWJ2cVNCRUE2NzBhRWlYYV9aSWNSY0w0cEh5dHpyYmtIeFVVNjVvdkp3RE5renIyS3BpMkNtSm1DaVAyN2ZF)）。

**后续观察**：美伊冲突走向决定油价与全球经济走向；曼谷火灾或促泰国加强娱乐场所安检；中国AI大会将展现全球治理立场，需关注具体成果；人工客服退化趋势反映效率与人性化矛盾，建议企业平衡技术应用。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by renewed hostilities between the U.S. and Iran, a devastating fire in Bangkok, and the death of beloved actor Sam Neill. Regional developments in Europe, Asia, and Australia reveal shifting political landscapes, escalating security threats, and growing tensions around AI governance and labor relations.

- **U.S.-Iran Conflict Escalates:** The U.S. launched new attacks on Iran following Trump's announcement of a renewed blockade and tolls in the Strait of Hormuz, pushing oil prices to a one-month high near $85/barrel. Iranian media reported explosions in Kish, Qeshm, and Bandar Abbas, threatening a return to all-out war after last month's ceasefire ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c2ly580kxnko), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/13/nx-s1-5891746/us-iran-strait-of-hormuz-updates)).
- **Bangkok Bar Fire Kills at Least 28:** A fire engulfed a bar in Bangkok's Chatuchak district, killing at least 28 and critically injuring 25. Survivors described crawling through flames and explosions ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c24yev53q06o), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crr8gnx01d7o)).
- **Actor Sam Neill Dies at 78:** Tributes flooded in for the 'Jurassic Park' star, who died suddenly. Director George Miller called him 'comprehensively an amazing person' ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy06e5e1lygo), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/live/2026/jul/14/australia-news-live-nt-police-peter-falconio-anthony-albanese-ai-artificial-intelligence-copyright-antisemitism-royal-commission-bondi-universities-ntwnfb)).
- **Spain Wildfire Tragedy:** A Briton survived a wildfire in Spain by staying in his car, but his wife and friends died trying to run to safety ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cp9ld3p324jo)).
- **Australia: AI Regulation and Hospitality Wars:** Minister Ed Husic warned that AI companies cannot be trusted to self-regulate, while police arrested a 20-year-old allegedly orchestrating Melbourne arson attacks linked to an overseas crime syndicate ([The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/live/2026/jul/14/australia-news-live-nt-police-peter-falconio-anthony-albanese-ai-artificial-intelligence-copyright-antisemitism-royal-commission-bondi-universities-ntwnfb), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/jul/14/melbourne-hospitality-hospo-wars-arrest-ntwnfb)).
- **Hungary Parliament Removes President:** Tamás Sulyok, a loyalist of former PM Viktor Orbán, was voted out of office after Orbán lost power in April ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cp8r002gdevo)).
- **Japan: Knife Attack and Disaster Agency:** A man was arrested after stabbing four people in Oita Prefecture; the Upper House passed a bill to establish a disaster management agency ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxNSFhkT2N1TlJXVmt4UTRUOEtpMFpKODRXeGJtLXFSekF2VUNRdkRXTFVoaDBsZFZxUlV4UEZoQTFxZS1RV3o4MHdKOVlKY3pOZzVFczl3ek13N3VVT3pyaG5scGJNdlltakJWY3podVBPcGw0aUI5YUV4bklFcFJfSkkxb0tvdTQ1ZEhiN3lScUw3QQ), [Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxNRXo3VS1JdV9EMHZXaTFOQnFhdEhRVmM2dFlVSm45OTRzNkprSllQa0wxbWFHRDB0SE16LXo1V3dqbUZTVV8xeFZMdVR2blFPNDhiVlBCM1FITFR2UGoxX3ExMngyZmlxYWZTcFJGU2xVak96YUQ3dnRPeWh4ZjBsNGdNcTcwY3ZRb0lMSHJfSkNlU3BLWGRycHladw)).
- **China: Xi to Address World AI Conference:** International anticipation builds for President Xi's speech at the 2026 World AI Conference, expected to emphasize China's role in global AI governance ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE53eHhuR2llS3FTS3JUSVd0cUY4b0xiVVFlN3VxMmdld3BQdXQxdkU3bVhIaUhvTEN0YUtKcERRODRDaExzQk9HRzFqU3NlSFRwb3BlbkZsYV9kV0F2NXd0MEYtWk5FMFRjMEdVSFRGY2pKQlhNU1ZjNjZ2UG82VzA)).

**Watch next:** The trajectory of U.S.-Iran conflict will dominate global headlines, with potential spillover effects on energy markets and regional stability. The aftermath of the Bangkok fire may prompt scrutiny of safety regulations. AI governance developments in China and Australia will shape policy debates in tech and security circles.

military.zh:
过去24小时，中东局势急剧恶化。美伊停火仅维持不到一个月即告破裂，[特朗普宣布对伊朗发动第三轮打击并重启霍尔木兹海峡封锁](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQTzk5TkVyaXI1Tl9tMUgxc20zOHBTTVk5M1NyX1lJd3MtYnFfVW9xV2dJR1p2Q1RVb3ZqRkRFRXBCM1N0VVdJTlRLT0R6Z0w0U1FLYlhfMXpFWGxFZ2htTmk1UGlmWEJ5THUwVzAwRWU4NUdxVnQzN2pUOENDbTVOekNfcld6R3RWN1h5US1vVkk1QzgtQUlhWXdaYnNvV3VyOFZuODJLcjAwbl94U2Y1cGN6VEJiM1BDTngwQXdoMzQ)。美军首次在实战中使用[自杀式无人艇攻击伊朗潜艇和港口设施](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/13/video-3-lethal-u-s-drones-attack-iranian-sub-port-facility)，标志着海战形态的转折。胡塞武装随即[袭击沙特机场](https://news.google.)，冲突持续外溢。与此同时，[9国支持乌克兰生产Freyja反导系统](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/07/14/9-nations-back-ukraines-patriot-alternative-freyja-and-want-it-flying-in-a-year/)，[法国批准乌克兰生产Aster-30拦截弹](https://www.twz.com/land/ukraine-getting-license-to-build-aster-30-anti-missile-interceptors)，大幅提升基辅的防空能力。俄罗斯耗资50亿美元的“纳希莫夫海军上将”号核动力巡洋舰历经27年大修后重新入列，但被批评为“一切问题的纪念碑”。中国方面，在南海仲裁案十周年之际，官媒密集发声，坚持“不接受、不承认”立场，并批驳14国联合声明。美军在印太地区持续演练，[陆战队试验Bullseye巡航导弹](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/usmc-general-atomics-bullseye-missile-china/)，海军则寻求“海底优势”。

**后续观察：** 美伊冲突已进入新阶段，美国首次使用无人艇作战将加速各国发展反无人艇战术，霍尔木兹海峡的再度封锁可能推高全球油价。乌克兰获得多国反导技术转让后，俄军导弹袭击的效果将进一步被削弱。南海方向，随着仲裁案十周年，各方外交博弈可能升级，需关注美国是否会借机强化在南海的军事存在。
military.en: The past 24 hours have seen a dramatic escalation in the US-Iran conflict, with Washington launching a third consecutive night of strikes and reinstating a naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz. This rapid breakdown of a one-month-old ceasefire—combined with the first-ever combat use of US unmanned surface vessels, new Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, and parallel developments in Ukraine and the South China Sea—is reshaping global military and economic risk calculations. Below are the key developments to watch.

tech.zh:
今天是2026年7月14日，科技圈迎来了几件足以重塑格局的大事：**OnePlus正式宣布退出美国及欧洲市场**，[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/965084/oneplus-oppo-exit-us-europe)证实了这一传闻已久的计划，这标志着中国手机品牌在海外高端市场的又一次战略收缩，其母公司Oppo的后续动向值得关注。另一边，**马斯克与奥特曼在社交媒体上互怼**，焦点是太空数据中心的可行性，[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/13/sam-altmans-space-data-center-trash-talk-is-what-most-experts-already-believe/)指出多数专家支持奥特曼的质疑——太空数据中心短期内更像炒作而非现实。在AI领域，**Monzo联合创始人Tom Blomfield加入Anthropic**，[Google News AI](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNZXVoTzE0ckpodS1TTXctRkVKQmZlZ1hqN1R0YTFSZGdtZktHcnd3MjRySEk4cGZpczBLQmVRM29XdVNEOHVFalBrRkh4YkcxYzJYd01NZnZTaFEzTExqWG5weDBKeVFsRGRienZ2SV9hRUhqdVJFYVpIUld5U05wSzhialVOYlNKM1FpUThwUUxzMXJiMVNPMWM4dkh2UQ)报道，AI人才战进一步升温；同时[Anthropic发布了Claude Science](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-science-ai-workbench)，一个面向科学家的AI工作台，试图将大模型深度嵌入研究流程。汽车板块，**特斯拉宣称正在得州制造一款轮椅可用的Robotaxi**，[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/13/tesla-wheelchair-accessible-robotaxi/)和[Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/tesla-says-its-building-a-wheelchair-accessible-robotaxi/)同时报道，但均未给出时间表，更像是政治表态；而**加州新的EV补贴方案**倾向于Rivian和Lucid，[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/13/california-ev-rebate-rivian-lucid-tesla/)分析称特斯拉因总部在得州而处于不利地位。此外，**乌克兰无人机一周内迫使俄罗斯暂停亚速海航运**，[Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/07/ukrainian-drone-strikes-forced-russia-to-stop-shipping-in-vital-sea-corridor/)的报道展示了廉价无人机对关键基础设施的颠覆性影响。在Hacker News社区，**一篇题为“AI不是人类，请停止像对待人类一样谈论它”的文章**引发热议，[The Free Press](https://www.thefp.com/p/artificial-intelligence-not-human)戳中了技术迷思的痛点；同时斯坦福大学的《无线通信基础》免费教材重新上榜，[原始链接](https://web.stanford.edu/~dntse/wireless_book.html)获得52点积分。

**后续观察：** OnePlus退出欧美将改变中端手机市场竞争格局；AI人才从金融科技流向基础模型公司表明产业重心正在上移；特斯拉的Robotaxi承诺需要实物落地才能取信于众；而无人机与AI结合带来的非对称威胁，值得安全领域持续跟踪。
tech.en:
The past 24 hours in tech news were dominated by market realignments, from OnePlus’s rumored retreat from the US and Europe to General Fusion’s public-market debut. The EV sector saw a flood of activity: new models, battery breakthroughs, and subsidy politics that favor domestic manufacturers. In AI, recruiting wars escalated and the social costs of data-center expansion hit a raw nerve in Georgia. Meanwhile, SpaceX readies Starship’s 13th flight and Google’s Pixel 11 color leaks offered a rare design surprise.

- **OnePlus’s potential exit from US and Europe** signals a major retreat for a brand that once defined flagship-killer value. The move, attributed to parent Oppo’s strategy shift, could leave a significant gap in the mid-to-premium Android market. [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/965084/oneplus-oppo-exit-us-europe)
- **SpaceX is gearing up for Starship’s 13th test flight**, which will push the vehicle’s pressure limits and deploy new Starlink satellites in orbit. A successful flight would be a critical step toward operational cadence. [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/space/2026/07/spacex-is-gearing-up-for-starships-13th-test-flight-later-this-week/)
- **General Fusion became the first publicly traded fusion company** after its Nasdaq debut popped, signaling investor appetite for next-gen energy even as technical milestones remain distant. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/13/investors-send-general-fusion-soaring-in-debut-as-first-publicly-traded-fusion-company/)
- **California’s new $3,500 EV rebate** explicitly favors automakers headquartered in the state, putting Rivian and Lucid ahead of Tesla. This policy twist could reshape incentive flows and competitive dynamics. [Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/13/california-ev-rebate-rivian-lucid-tesla/)
- **Japan’s new lithium recovery method** (up to 90% efficiency) from used EV batteries could lessen dependence on mining and lower battery costs—a potential game-changer for recycling economics. [Hacker News](https://tech.supercarblondie.com/japan-recovers-up-to-90-of-lithium-from-used-ev-batteries/)
- **The AI talent war intensified** as Monzo co-founder Tom Blomfield joined Anthropic, and veteran tech founders returned to the trenches, driven by the fear of missing AI’s defining moment. [Google News AI](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNZXVoTzE0ckpodS1TTXctRkVKQmZlZ1hqN1R0YTFSZGdtZktHcnd3MjRySEk4cGZpczBLQmVRM29XdVNEOHVFalBrRkh4YkcxYzJYd01NZnZTaFEzTExqWG5weDBKeVFsRGRienZ2SV9hRUhqdVJFYVpIUld5U05wSzhialVOYlNKM1FpUThwUUxzMXJiMVNPMWM4dkh2UQ)
- **A Georgia family claims eminent domain is being used to power AI data centers**—a stark real-world conflict between AI infrastructure expansion and property rights. [CBS News via HN](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/georgia-power-ai-data-centers-eminent-domain/)
- **Google’s Pixel 11 color palette leaked**, showing hot pink, vibrant green, and midnight black—a bold departure from recent muted tones that could signal a design refresh. [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/964972/google-pixel-11-colors-rumor)

**Watch next:** OnePlus’s official announcement later this week could trigger a wave of consumer panic-buying and competitive jockeying. Starship’s flight readiness will test SpaceX’s manifest for the rest of 2026. In AI, keep an eye on Anthropic’s recruiting momentum following Blomfield’s hire—and any policy responses to the Georgia eminent domain case.

sports.zh:
**体育日报 | 2026-07-14**

世界杯半决赛一触即发，法国、西班牙、阿根廷、英格兰四强争锋，赛前伤病与心态成为焦点。转会市场方面，曼联接连出手签下桑托斯并接近蒂勒曼斯，维拉截胡曼赞比。篮球圈46岁斯科拉转型掌门人引发热议，虎扑社区围绕世界杯数据与NBA交易传闻展开激烈讨论。羽毛球国羽全主力出征日本公开赛，卫冕之旅正式开启。

- **世界杯四强大数据对决**：BBC统计了四强在半决赛前的关键数据——法国最有效率，西班牙控球主导，阿根廷依赖梅西，英格兰定位球威胁。其中西班牙罗德里以597次传球领跑传球榜，[世界杯传球榜罗德里597次居首](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxQMmpmWUJJaWtCejBjZ2YzVmR3UGRzbzk3U2lYVXZkS3h2dENsNTlQckl4bnB5OGhGXzdnRnBSTGF4bkt2Zm0yenJQX1A0YkQ1TzBXbkI4a0xvN0Jlbm11U3pyRjFWZi14bmlUcnNFalBaQVVPdUlPTHpXZ3JHc0xoMWlpRW1RTG81bjVpcnlldlc1bjQ)。
- **英法各有关键变数**：英格兰队长凯恩强调“球队完全团结”，但中场核心赖斯能否出战半决赛需赛前决定；[英格兰将做赖斯出场晚决定](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce8m996g9g1o)。法国主帅德尚预测半决赛场面“壮观”，[德尚预测壮观法西半决赛](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c79y29l32gxo)。
- **曼联转会连签两人**：曼联以4800万镑从切尔西签下安德烈·桑托斯，并接近与阿斯顿维拉就蒂勒曼斯达成协议，[曼联签桑托斯并接近蒂勒曼斯](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cn07dpgkj4eo)。
- **维拉截胡纽卡签曼赞比**：罗马诺确认，阿斯顿维拉以超6000万欧转会费截胡纽卡斯尔签下曼赞比，[HWG！罗马诺：维拉截胡纽卡签曼赞比](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE5MbG9hcC1HeE5jamctZGFYYUlDbFRJY3A1X0xNSlRNenpXQVdpNXJWckRHcWZWUVBlUGlpWUVnRUw3VkJoNG85LUdOVVUzb21HRjdkRGU0bw)。
- **斯科拉46岁成为球队掌门人**：前阿根廷男篮名将路易斯·斯科拉被任命为某球队掌门人，家庭幸福，四子齐心，引发“姚明会羡慕吗”的讨论，[姚明会羡慕吗？46岁斯科拉成球队掌门人](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPamJyQXdkdk9Kb2tLZGZnRFNXSEhBS2FkRzRTaTVGMDBxMTc2bmIyWHlGdkZYOXAwaU1QbXhTWXJ5NUhZQ2MxUWFENTB5dzlHQ3YzX2JCNVNhZjVici1MM0VkZUUtLXZUNzFZNDFIaFh1VWU5RWg3eDZJTUZ1YmFVeURvdTZqREdLdG56Ng)。
- **国羽出征日本公开赛**：2026年日本羽毛球公开赛开赛在即，中国队全主力出战，石宇奇、刘圣书/谭宁开启卫冕征程，[2026日本公开赛前瞻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxOenlnQ1hRVEszOFRLd2hmcWljX0NUbGdKa3JXZ1I3UWZSUkx6LW12V2hqalpubWd5QUszSWlFZ2RBX1NzX2RQdzBUY21kd0ZlUzgzTTNwVnN0M2dXMjVMX2pqcUVRN3BWb1BjbGVZTzEtalFxWlpqbEtsR1pmN19odTFmejNfZGlBelNXX05PN1pTenFRai1lSzNFTzd5azRsS3ZPMHYya3c5MWZxRjdjSmR1Y2NvZDBkUjhVZGZMdGJ6eHFqS0IwYg)。

**后续观察**：世界杯半决赛结果将直接影响决赛对阵及后续金球奖风向；曼联若压哨签下蒂勒曼斯，中场配置将大幅升级。斯科拉转型管理层或将带动更多退役球星参与俱乐部经营。国羽在日本公开赛的表现将决定奥运会前积分排序，需关注石宇奇能否卫冕。
sports.en:
The sports world is fixated on the World Cup semi-finals, with France facing Spain and England taking on Argentina in what promises to be two blockbuster matchups. Meanwhile, the summer transfer window continues to shake up the Premier League, Chinese basketball is heating up with grassroots tournaments, and China's badminton stars are preparing to defend their titles at the Japan Open. Here are the key stories from the past 24 hours:

- **World Cup Semi-Final Showdowns**: France manager Didier Deschamps promises a "spectacular" clash against Spain, while England captain Harry Kane insists the squad is "completely together" ahead of their meeting with Argentina. England will make a late call on Declan Rice's fitness ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c79y29l32gxo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c8924433kjyo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce8m996g9g1o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)).
- **Tactical Deep Dive**: Statistical comparisons show France are the most clinical and Spain the least creative among the final four, while Spain's Rodri leads the tournament with 597 passes ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cx2k9qj2nyvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [虎扑](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxQMmpmWUJJaWtCejBjZ2YzVmR3UGRzbzk3U2lYVXZkS3h2dENsNTlQckl4bnB5OGhGXzdnRnBSTGF4bkt2Zm0yenJQX1A0YkQ1TzBXbkI4a0xvN0Jlbm11U3pyRjFWZi14bmlUcnNFalBaQVVPdUlPTHpXZ3JHc0xoMWlpRW1RTG81bjVpcnlldlc1bjQ)).
- **Premier League Transfer Frenzy**: Manchester United have signed Andrey Santos from Chelsea for £48m and are closing in on Youri Tielemans. Aston Villa are assessing a move for Pervis Estupinan, and Tottenham's Djed Spence is attracting Inter Milan interest ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cn07dpgkj4eo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cm2jlg3el4no?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/live-blog/12040/13025489/tottenham-transfer-news-rumours-and-gossip-live-updates-and-latest-on-deals-signings-loans-and-contracts)).
- **Basketball: Scola Takes Charge**: 46-year-old Luis Scola has become the president of a basketball club, building a family dynasty with his four sons. The story draws comparisons with Yao Ming's career path ([搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPamJyQXdkdk9Kb2tLZGZnRFNXSEhBS2FkRzRTaTVGMDBxMTc2bmIyWHlGdkZYOXAwaU1QbXhTWXJ5NUhZQ2MxUWFENTB5dzlHQ3YzX2JCNVNhZjVici1MM0VkZUUtLXZUNzFZNDFIaFh1VWU5RWg3eDZJTUZ1YmFVeURvdTZqREdLdG56Ng)).
- **Badminton: China Sends Full Squad to Japan Open**: World champions Shi Yuqi and women's doubles pair Liu Shengshu/Tan Ning begin their title defences at the 2026 Japan Open, leading a strong Chinese contingent ([Olympics.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxOenlnQ1hRVEszOFRLd2hmcWljX0NUbGdKa3JXZ1I3UWZSUkx6LW12V2hqalpubWd5QUszSWlFZ2RBX1NzX2RQdzBUY21kd0ZlUzgzTTNwVnN0M2dXMjVMX2pqcUVRN3BWb1BjbGVZTzEtalFxWlpqbEtsR1pmN19odTFmejNfZGlBelNXX05PN1pTenFRai1lSzNFTzd5azRsS3ZPMHYya3c5MWZxRjdjSmR1Y2NvZDBkUjhVZGZMdGJ6eHFqS0IwYg)).
- **虎扑 Community Buzz**: Crossover discussions include NBA trade rumours (Heat exploring Klay Thompson deal), transfer news (Villa hijacking Manzambi for €60m+), and esports highlights (G2's BrokenBlade MVP vs T1) ([腾讯](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFBEU01KUUtLVmVqT3RPeFVWQ29DeWNNR25GNkF5d1lPa2FhU0JBMGZCblVxRzM1X05jQXd1eE1aMmlLbmZydUdFdkhhV1pnMkdmaDh6Y1VB), [腾讯](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE5MbG9hcC1HeE5jamctZGFYYUlDbFRJY3A1X0xNSlRNenpXQVdpNXJWckRHcWZWUVBlUGlpWUVnRUw3VkJoNG85LUdOVVUzb21HRjdkRGU0bw), [MSN](https://news.google.)).

**Watch next**: All eyes are on the World Cup semi-finals (Wed 15 July). Expect late fitness calls on Rice and further transfer developments as clubs accelerate business ahead of the window closing. The Japan Open badminton tournament kicks off, and 虎扑 will continue to track NBA trade rumours and esports action.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐新闻板块呈现多线并行的格局：美国传媒巨头Warner Bros. Discovery与Paramount的合并案在司法和资本层面同时遭遇阻力——CEO David Zaslav再度抛售约5947万美元股票（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/david-zaslav-selling-warner-bros-discovery-stock-1236981468/) / [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/david-zaslav-sells-59-million-warner-bros-discovery-stock-1236810050/)）的同时，12个州的检察长申请临时限制令企图叫停合并（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/paramount-warner-bros-merger-temporary-restraining-order-1236981542/)）；而Paramount新任CEO David Ellison则在同日奔赴华盛顿推动一项联邦电影税收激励法案（[Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/paramount-david-ellison-federal-film-tax-incentive-1236810169/)）。亚洲方面，香港电影巨匠施南生逝世，享年75岁，她的离世标志着华语电影黄金时代的一个符号性落幕（[Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/nansun-shi-dead-infernal-affairs-producer-1236647162/) / [中国娱乐网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE9YRVBRaHFpRkpDZ0owX01DTEVwb3BhbmVQNnQtRUVmVGgtczBkb3JqNUxCTlRuTzNkTzZrbUc0dFlreFlRZXBXMnZSZW9OVGNJUkNuTkd5SFJacnM)）。微博社区则因“瑞鹤娱乐”连续两日热搜第一及“苏新皓被三大公司争抢”的传闻引发热议。整体看，资本博弈、政策游说与行业人物悼念构成了今日新闻的主线。
- **传媒合并战升级**：除Zaslav套现外，12州检察长要求法院暂停Paramount与WBD合并，最快可能在7月22日前完成交易（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/paramount-warner-bros-merger-temporary-restraining-order-1236981542/)）。同时，Paramount CEO David Ellison在周一与众议院筹款委员会成员会面，推动联邦电影税收抵免（[Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/david-ellisons-bipartisan-federal-film-tax-incentive-1236647220/)）。
- **施南生去世**：这位《无间道》制片人、新艺城影业联合创始人在香港电影黄金时代留下不可磨灭的印记，其去世获得中美媒体一致报道（[Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/nansun-shi-dead-infernal-affairs-producer-1236647162/) / [中国娱乐网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE9YRVBRaHFpRkpDZ0owX01DTEVwb3BhbmVQNnQtRUVmVGgtczBkb3JqNUxCTlRuTzNkTzZrbUc0dFlreFlRZXBXMnZSZW9OVGNJUkNuTkd5SFJacnM)）。
- **韩国偶像合约变动**：TWICE成员周子瑜被传将离开JYP娱乐，JYP仅简短回应，但表示其仍会参与团体活动（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854483wpp/tzuyu-reported-to-part-ways-with-jyp-jyp-briefly-comments-on-twices-contract-renewals)），引发粉丝对TWICE完整性的担忧。
- **“瑞鹤娱乐”连续霸榜微博**：粉丝向瑞鹤娱乐递维权公开信，公司是否回应成焦点，连日占据热搜第一（[新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1aUElVaGVLNTNOdkFSaHNjU2FLNk9sb3RUaTE5WEZNRmk5ZjNnZGF4ZWk3em5MT3FHUHRQWHRhSl96LVhmT2VXOG0tNmdVZEhKRDIxeDJoV1l0RmRrR0E4eHV1dw)）。
- **电影市场观察**：迪士尼真人版《Moana》北美开画失利，引发对迪士尼翻拍策略的质疑（[Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/moana-disney-live-action-remake-box-office-dwayne-johnson-1236647014/)）；越南喜剧《Mr. Hero》则在纽约亚洲电影节首映后将进行全球发行（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/thai-hoa-mr-hero-vietnam-skyline-media-north-america-1236980649/)）。
- **Jon Stewart炮轰特朗普**：在《每日秀》中，Stewart严厉批评特朗普对参议员Lindsey Graham去世的冷淡反应（[Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/jon-stewart-donald-trump-reaction-lindsey-graham-daily-show-1236810256/)）。

**后续观察**：派拉蒙-WBD合并案的时间表高度不确定，欧盟本周的裁决和州法院的临时限制令将决定交易走向；David Ellison的联邦税收激励动议能否在国会获得两党支持值得关注；周子瑜的去留将直接影响TWICE未来的团体活动频率；“瑞鹤娱乐”维权事件是否会有官方回应，将决定微博舆论的后续发酵方向。
entertainment.en:
The entertainment landscape is dominated by seismic corporate maneuvering and legacy shifts. In the US, the proposed Paramount-WBD merger faces a fresh legal hurdle as state attorneys general seek a temporary restraining order, while WBD CEO David Zaslav continues to cash out nearly $60M in stock. Meanwhile, the passing of Hong Kong cinema titan Nansun Shi at 75 marks the end of an era, and Disney’s live-action *Moana* sink at the box office raises questions about remake strategy. In K-pop, TWICE’s Tzuyu is reportedly leaving JYP after 11 years, signaling a major group recalibration. Chinese entertainment sees a strategic tech-culture partnership between 咖魔科技 and 华策影视, alongside heated Weibo debates over talent agency wars involving trainee Su Xinhao.

- **[David Zaslav Selling $59.5M in WBD Shares](https://deadline.com/2026/07/david-zaslav-selling-warner-bros-discovery-stock-1236981468/)** – As the Paramount-WBD merger hangs in regulatory limbo, the CEO is liquidating stock ahead of his expected departure; multiple outlets confirm the sale.
- **[State AGs Seek Restraining Order to Pause Paramount-WBD Merger](https://deadline.com/2026/07/paramount-warner-bros-merger-temporary-restraining-order-1236981542/)** – A 12-state antitrust lawsuit now includes a request to block the deal before a potential EU decision on July 22.
- **[Nansun Shi, ‘Infernal Affairs’ Producer, Dies at 75](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/nansun-shi-dead-infernal-affairs-producer-1236647162/)** – The Film Workshop co-founder shaped Hong Kong’s golden age; her death reverberates across the Chinese film industry.
- **[‘Moana’ Live-Action Opens Weak, Disney Remake Strategy Questioned](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/moana-disney-live-action-remake-box-office-dwayne-johnson-1236647014/)** – Despite the animated sequel’s success, the remake’s soft debut fuels doubts about Disney’s reliance on nostalgia.
- **[Tzuyu Reportedly Leaving JYP Entertainment](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854483wpp/tzuyu-reported-to-part-ways-with-jyp-jyp-briefly-comments-on-twices-contract-renewals)** – TWICE’s Tzuyu is reportedly departing her agency of 11 years, though she may continue group activities; JYP has briefly commented.
- **[周星驰‘严选’ and Legacy: 70万片酬拍爆30亿! 华谊破产 Truth](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE5ORld5RkhGSHdSNFJTcXdYNUk1eEZJUmM2V3UwZ2cxLWcxVVVlSExmYUwtTmliaHhGVmNITDJoYkxqdVlVbmZsMnJyUDNyMEFsMGMtdFZOSzRIMlYtOGY5VWZlZGZYZy1Qb3JPU1ZuZw)** – A viral narrative ties Stephen Chow’s past salary battles to Huayi Brothers’ bankruptcy, stirring industry debate.
- **[Weibo Frenzy: Three Agencies Vying for Trainee Su Xinhao](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE5JeWhENjdNX0FRRC1wZUZ4Q1cwN2RfZzJVQmhwa2RLa2VPRWE3UjdpSnRkWHJhX0g4ZGRUVnNUZUNxLXpRT2RiLU1ERVFFd1AtM3pYNVR3czZ4QXQ4dUI0cWxydEtyS0lWZlh0bVVzS0Y)** – Unconfirmed rumors of a bidding war among Top, Yuehua, and JYP dominate community discussions, with no agency confirmation.

**Watch next:** The Paramount-WBD merger’s fate hangs on the July 22 EU decision and the restraining order hearing. TWICE’s contract renewal saga will unfold in coming days. The Chinese film community will likely honor Nansun Shi with retrospectives, while the Su Xinhao talent war may trigger official statements from the agencies involved.

美股.zh:
地缘风险主导美股情绪。油价飙升叠加特朗普重启伊朗封锁，市场避险情绪升温，科技股承压。与此同时，Paramount-Warner Bros的1100亿美元合并遭加州等12州起诉，娱乐业整合面临阻力。日本债券市场在政策正常化后获投资者重新关注，可能分流部分美股资金。

- **油价大涨与航运风险**：布伦特原油涨5%，特朗普计划对霍尔木兹海峡船舶征收20%通行费，加剧供应担忧。[油价报道](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-hormuz-trump-toll-iran.html)
- **Paramount-WB合并遇阻**：加州等12州起诉，认为合并将伤害影院和娱乐业，面临数千人失业。[诉讼详情](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/13/business/paramount-warner-bros-lawsuit.html)
- **中国出口数据利好美股相关板块**：中国6月对美出口增长14%，AI、电子元件需求强劲，利好苹果、英伟达等供应链公司。[中国出口数据](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/china-june-trade-data-exports-imports.html) 
- **美联储人事与政策**：美联储宣布货币政策推进任务组领导层，反洗钱新规征求意见中。[美联储公告](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260709a.htm)

短期美股将跟随油价波动，能源板块受益，但科技、消费类可能承压，市场需消化地缘风险溢价。
美股.en:
U.S. markets are on edge as a fresh wave of Mideast tensions and a blockbuster Chinese trade print compete for attention. Oil’s 5% rally and Trump’s 20% Hormuz toll plan have reignited inflation fears, while a dozen states moved to block the Paramount-Warner Bros merger, signaling heightened antitrust scrutiny in media. The Federal Reserve’s latest enforcement actions and anti-money laundering proposals add a regulatory layer.

- **[Oil gains over 2% as Mideast tensions and Hormuz toll prospects raise supply worries](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-hormuz-trump-toll-iran.html)** – Brent crude rose 5% Monday and another 2% Tuesday. The 20% toll threatens the global oil surplus and could push gasoline prices higher, directly impacting U.S. consumer spending and Fed policy.
- **[China exports in June rise at fastest pace since 2021 as AI boom, tariff rush lift trade](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/china-june-trade-data-exports-imports.html)** – Exports to the U.S. jumped ~14%; imports surged 26%. This provides a tailwind for U.S. tech and retail stocks exposed to Chinese demand, but also raises the risk of retaliatory tariffs.
- **[Paramount-Warner Bros. Merger Is Challenged in Court by California and 11 Other States](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/13/business/paramount-warner-bros-lawsuit.html)** – The lawsuit argues the $110bn deal would harm competition. If blocked, it could reset M&A appetite in the entertainment sector.
- **[Federal Reserve announces task forces to advance monetary policy](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260709a.htm)** – The Fed’s new task forces on policy conduct suggest internal readiness for unconventional tools, possibly signaling a shift in forward guidance.

**Signal:** The combination of an oil shock and an antitrust offensive creates a high-volatility setup for U.S. equities. Sectors to watch: energy (beneficiary), airlines/transport (cost pressure), and media (deal risk).

欧洲经济.zh:
ECB官员表态聚焦欧洲增长韧性，但地缘冲突引发的油价飙升加剧通胀担忧。欧洲并购活动展现出比全球同行更强的韧性，但住房市场流动性陷阱正在演变为劳动力市场问题，波兰经济对乌克兰工人依赖加深。美国司法部调查UAW主席涉及腐败指控，或影响美国汽车业工会关系。

- **ECB官员发声**：Piero Cipollone接受采访，Isabel Schnabel发表关于促进欧洲增长与韧性的演讲。[ECB采访](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/inter/date/2026/html/ecb.in260713~d928475792.en.html) | [Schnabel演讲](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/key/date/2026/html/ecb.sp260713~e78632b27a.en.pdf)
- **住房-劳动力陷阱**：欧洲住房流动性差阻碍劳动力市场优化，经济学家警告长期经济效率受损。[分析文章](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE5Ld0pkYUZUYWJUS2lxcmZqU2MtRTFrc210Z1F3ZFkyd2cxeVhhX0FxRnVYYXBYVEtlNGRIcHNleFN2dnh4dEhBUFFyUy1rQndkQjJXZEFJVzFaUQ)
- **欧洲并购韧性**：尽管ECB加息，欧洲M&A活动仍强于全球同行，显示企业信心尚在。[报道](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPOTZ5MEM1LVVaYUxERjhlTEpETWRDVHpmLVJKUlhPbDliZEFoZHl5NTh6dm1EVTRDRHMyWkpiTzd2LW1RR2EwdkRuOVU3aVJEeHlqQkNOVWlING5iSlItaVhQUXJoS3hpVzJtaHA2d1NfejV3YjIwd1k5Um01YjljeDZMdkNBWEYw)
- **UAW主席被调查**：美国司法部调查UAW主席Shawn Fain涉嫌腐败，其称指控“虚假”。[报道](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jul/13/justice-department-uaw-president-investigation)

油价飙升对欧洲能源进口国构成输入性通胀压力，ECB或更难放松政策，欧洲股市可能延续震荡。
欧洲经济.en:
European markets are navigating a mixed picture: the ECB continues to emphasize resilience and structural reforms, but a housing mobility trap is emerging as a labour market drag. Oil’s spike poses a stagflation risk, though M&A activity remains surprisingly robust. The U.S.-Iran conflict could hit Europe harder via energy costs, yet defense spending is lifting the space economy.

- **[Isabel Schnabel: How to foster growth and resilience in Europe](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/key/date/2026/html/ecb.sp260713~e78632b27a.en.pdf)** – Schnabel’s speech underscores the ECB’s focus on boosting productivity and resilience, implicitly acknowledging that rate hikes alone cannot fix structural weaknesses.
- **[Europe’s Housing Mobility Trap Is Now A Labour Market Problem](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE5Ld0pkYUZUYWJUS2lxcmZqU2MtRTFrc210Z1F3ZFkyd2cxeVhhX0FxRnVYYXBYVEtlNGRIcHNleFN2dnh4dEhBUFFyUy1rQndkQjJXZEFJVzFaUQ)** – High housing costs are preventing workers from moving to jobs, a structural headwind to employment growth. This complicates the ECB’s inflation outlook by limiting labour supply.
- **[European M&A proves more resilient than global peers despite ECB rate hike](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPOTZ5MEM1LVVaYUxERjhlTEpETWRDVHpmLVJKUlhPbDliZEFoZHl5NTh6dm1EVTRDRHMyWkpiTzd2LW1RR2EwdkRuOVU3aVJEeHlqQkNOVWlING5iSlItaVhQUXJoS3hpVzJtaHA2d1NfejV3YjIwd1k5Um01YjljeDZMdkNBWEYw)** – Deal activity is holding up, especially in defense and space, where rising government spending provides a buffer against higher financing costs.
- **[Defense spending lifts Europe’s space economy](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE5SWF9LX1lZUzF1YTU1OGk1eW9UVjI1cDI1Nkxaa3l2QnlBWWMtM2ZVbmdDamRIdm5CMXRpY1UxNkVhdllNekFwaEl5U3o1TXJvdDlOdHhYbUxwREdvZlV0RXQyZWx0QkFXTUd2REpDNFdUWWJjdnc)** – NATO-aligned defense budgets are funneling into space-based assets, creating a new growth vertical for European tech and manufacturing companies.

**Signal:** European equities may outperform in a risk-off scenario if the ECB holds steady on rates and defense spending accelerates, but the oil shock and housing drag are serious headwinds. Watch upcoming PMI data for confirmation.

中国经济.zh:
外部需求强劲与地缘风险形成拉锯。中国6月出口增速超预期，AI相关产品出口亮眼，但进口增速更高，显示内需有所恢复。地缘冲突推高原油期货至涨9%，A股科创50跌超3%，资金向能源板块转移。香港楼市回暖，银行提高按揭回赠争夺客户。离岸人民币债券迎来里程碑：伦敦清算所接受作为抵押品，人民币国际化迈出一步。

- **6月进出口创纪录**：海关总署数据显示上半年进口首次突破10万亿元，增速高于出口8.7个百分点；电子元件、电脑零部件出口两位数增长拉动出口6.9个百分点。[进口数据](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTE5kS2RYeUxEMjNQYnJHeENWUGFUUWszY3hOSHdqblJXNloyZE9zRUFFc0RsQktTay1RX2hwazFMYkNKNUhaYlRUTTFJX2ROd0E1VnppLQ)
- **离岸人民币债券里程碑**：伦敦清算所（LCH）接受离岸人民币国债作为合格非现金抵押品，推动人民币国际化。[报道](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3360450/appetite-yuan-assets-sees-london-clearing-house-accept-dim-sum-bonds-collateral)
- **香港楼市银行争夺战**：中银香港、恒生、汇丰等提高按揭现金回赠至最高1.4%，创两年多新高。[报道](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3360407/hong-kong-banks-sweeten-mortgage-rebates-competition-heats-amid-property-rebound)
- **A股受油价冲击**：原油主力合约涨9%，科创50指数跌超3%，科技股资金外流。[原油涨9%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTFBDcDcwcTdncnRQdlFqc1ZKZmhrTzRPS1h1aURfZnFicWNZY0pXWlRBQ0EzMmM5ekN2aF81ZjJ0TGt1T3JqVjlJZ3N6dXdKb0M1SXk0) | [科创50跌超3%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE8yc1g1VjYzcFdlN0ZOXzFSc0pGcXRhdEZGaGJNU2ZITm40TUdtVW56bFpIV3Z1Q2R0Mndyd0ZiNHNiVi1VMHpDWTZYUjNFdWZxTnJv)
- **中国医疗设备企业转战欧洲**：国内反腐挤压利润，12%的采购下滑推动企业加速出海。[报道](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3360420/chinese-medical-device-makers-push-europe-anti-corruption-squeeze-bites-home)

人民币资产国际化与出口韧性构成支撑，但地缘冲突导致能源成本上升可能侵蚀企业利润，A股短期风格切换至防御。
中国经济.en:
China’s June trade data stole the spotlight, with exports growing at the fastest clip since 2021, driven by AI-related electronics and a tariff rush. Imports also hit a record high, signaling robust domestic demand. However, mainland stocks slipped as oil surged and tech stocks sold off, with the STAR 50 falling over 3%. The property market in Hong Kong showed signs of life as banks increased mortgage rebates, while medical device firms pivoted to Europe amid home anti-corruption probes.

- **[AI成全球货物贸易增长主线海关总署：上半年电子元件、电脑零部件等出口均两位数增长](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTFBUZWZaZW9lcTQyVlc5cG5WX2M0Tk1vQUV1c2xXVUFvUUx0aVJTWkh1S1FZclY2MkVCVjVQS0NMSFN4MFBZX0QySXlHSVZjbnVsYUtfVA)** – AI is the primary driver of export growth; electronics and computer components contributed 6.9 percentage points to total export growth in H1. This underscores China’s deepening role in global AI supply chains.
- **[海关总署：上半年我国进口历史同期首次突破10万亿元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTE5kS2RYeUxEMjNQYnJHeENWUGFUUWszY3hOSHdqblJXNloyZE9zRUFFc0RsQktTay1RX2hwazFMYkNKNUhaYlRUTTFJX2ROd0E1VnppLQ)** – Imports grew 8.7 percentage points faster than exports, a record high. Strong import demand suggests solid consumption and industrial activity, supporting the renminbi and global commodity producers.
- **[Hong Kong banks sweeten mortgage rebates to 1.4% as property demand recovers](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3360407/hong-kong-banks-sweeten-mortgage-rebates-competition-heats-amid-property-rebound)** – Competition among lenders is driving up cash rebates, indicating a nascent recovery in Hong Kong’s property market. However, the rebound is vulnerable to U.S. rate decisions.
- **[Oil surge hits mainland stocks: STAR 50 down 3%, Hang Seng edges higher](https://news.google.)** – The Hang Seng managed marginal gains (+0.1%) while mainland indices fell, reflecting divergent investor sentiment between Hong Kong and the mainland. Tech and oil importers were hit hardest.
- **[Chinese medical device makers push into Europe as anti-corruption squeeze bites at home](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3360420/chinese-medical-device-makers-push-europe-anti-corruption-squeeze-bites-home)** – Government hospital purchases fell 12% YoY in Jan-May due to anti-corruption probes, prompting companies to seek growth in Europe despite rising trade barriers. This is a strategic pivot with long-term R&D implications.

**Signal:** China’s trade engine is firing on AI, but the oil spike and domestic regulatory pressures (property, anti-corruption) are creating crosswinds. The renminbi’s internationalization got a boost from LCH accepting dim sum bonds as collateral – a structural development that could support yuan assets amid global uncertainty.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
社区热点聚焦科技与能源。长鑫科技本周四打新，中签率预计较高吸引散户关注；中科曙光与郑州国资成立智算公司；国内金饰价格集体下跌，最高1217元/克。融资买入方面，中际旭创单日获融资49.28亿元居首，显示资金对光模块龙头的看好。

- **长鑫科技打新**：周四开始申购，中签率预计较高，市场关注度提升。[长鑫科技打新](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTFBIaUNVRWQtVkYtYUI0SThLNVJWUlRPQ1JIMDl1dXptZWgxbFgwWHFkTEZLQXJjMkZ0eFQ3SjE4d1hRYUpUOGJhRGU0THNjRmQtcjNPNVRVdjVsLU1zSlYxRw)
- **中科曙光成立智算公司**：与郑州国资联合，布局智算基础设施。[中科曙光](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBTdnJjUC1aejhGNWk2TVVyVkQtbVBsdGMxaU13RzFBdHBBdVNwUEo1UzBBUlFFeDJYMVZaQWE5QW52VldaOVAzYkhpaG1kSi10V1ZubWZTbDN1OVM4WmMyOURn)
- **金饰价格下跌**：国内金店最高报1217元/克，集体回落，反映短期避险情绪降温。[金饰价格](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBwZkZYRDdJVjA0cDVsQ0Q1ZzhldWxfMWY5UEp3YngxVXB3TGFySHVoWDd3dHVydkJxTnJ4WDVvWm5sTGl2Z0V3cDJPMXRSX2xqNnpJbXM3YVU3MVNmT0E)
- **融资买入活跃**：7月13日413股获融资超亿元，中际旭创49.28亿元居首，光模块热度持续。[融资买入](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE90ZDdDWUx3SUpQVWJFaG16cHdHUXRxT0pNZVZJbEs5ZU9ZTmZwaEZWMnZ1dC1CVGdwcEdZbTFOZnBzckVVS19Gb3BZZ2lROG9PWFZraUdFcWNnTWlXanc)
- **中国芯+鸿蒙脑**：行业首款OpenHarmony原生自助服务产品落地深圳，国产自主生态再下一城。[中国芯+鸿蒙脑](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9HSGl3ZVNpeUp1QW5ZY1RZS1ljY3ExelVnOEhfM0xndzlmUjFmaGtKVi1ZU3ZyNS1DZkJnNUNldFhMN1Yyb21hS00xU3BnZ2R2b1ZVUnpMZU9uUUVYdnViSExB)

社区情绪偏积极，科技、半导体新股与智算主题受追捧，但需注意地缘冲突下风险偏好可能快速切换。
同花顺社区动态.en:
The Tonghuashun community is buzzing with a mix of corporate developments, IPO news, and market sentiment shifts. Key topics include a new AI computing joint venture (Zhongke Shuguang with Zhengzhou state assets), the upcoming IPO of CXMT (Changxin Technology) on Thursday, and a sharp drop in domestic gold jewelry prices. Financing flows show strong buying interest in Zhongji Innolight.

- **[长鑫科技本周四打新，中签率预计较高](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTFBIaUNVRWQtVkYtYUI0SThLNVJWUlRPQ1JIMDl1dXptZWgxbFgwWHFkTEZLQXJjMkZ0eFQ3SjE4d1hRYUpUOGJhRGU0THNjRmQtcjNPNVRVdjVsLU1zSlYxRw)** – CXMT (Changxin Technology) will start its IPO subscription on Thursday with a predicted high allotment ratio. This is a major event for the semiconductor sector and could attract significant retail interest.
- **[底部蓄力，TCL中环静待硅片景气反转](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9DTmFobHZ3R3lSREgtNXBrN1VsSnhoUFRuejJDR1RCaHBuWTdRNm02UXJyN09DdWc0YUNHd2c2X2tsaDlYdGJPbGJZVjVHYjVwN1VtTTNuajhpSVA2V3F0YXd3)** – TCL Zhonghuan is viewed as bottoming out, awaiting a cyclical turnaround in wafer prices. Investors are positioning for a recovery in solar/ semiconductor materials.
- **[国内多家金店金饰价格集体下跌，最高报1217元/克](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBwZkZYRDdJVjA0cDVsQ0Q1ZzhldWxfMWY5UEp3YngxVXB3TGFySHVoWDd3dHVydkJxTnJ4WDVvWm5sTGl2Z0V3cDJPMXRSX2xqNnpJbXM3YVU3MVNmT0E)** – Gold jewelry prices fell to as low as 1,217 yuan per gram, a notable decline that may reflect weak consumer demand or a correction in international gold prices. Community sentiment likely cautious.
- **[7月13日413股获融资买入超亿元 中际旭创获买入49.28亿元居首](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE90ZDdDWUx3SUpQVWJFaG16cHdHUXRxT0pNZVZJbEs5ZU9ZTmZwaEZWMnZ1dC1CVGdwcEdZbTFOZnBzckVVS19Gb3BZZ2lROG9PWFZraUdFcWNnTWlXanc)** – 413 stocks saw margin buying exceeding 100 million yuan, led by Zhongji Innolight at 4.9 billion yuan. This indicates high leverage and speculative interest in AI/optical components stocks.
- **[中科曙光、郑州国资等成立智算信息技术公司](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBTdnJjUC1aejhGNWk2TVVyVkQtbVBsdGMxaU13RzFBdHBBdVNwUEo1UzBBUlFFeDJYMVZaQWE5QW52VldaOVAzYkhpaG1kSi10V1ZubWZTbDN1OVM4WmMyOURn)** – Zhongke Shuguang partnered with Zhengzhou state capital to form a smart computing information company, aligning with national AI infrastructure push. This is a positive signal for the computing ecosystem.

**Signal:** The community is cautiously optimistic on chips and AI infrastructure, but the gold price drop and overall market weakness (STAR 50 down) suggest retail traders are hedging bets. The CXMT IPO will be a key test of appetite for semiconductor stocks in a volatile market.

欧美.zh:
欧美社会新闻跨度从地缘冲突到娱乐界悼念。美伊开战影响全球能源市场，伊朗称遭新攻击；西班牙山火致一家三口死亡，幸存者讲述汽车逃生经历；匈牙利议会投票罢免亲欧尔班总统；《侏罗纪公园》演员Sam Neill去世，享年78岁。此外，黄石公园野牛撞飞游客、澳洲墨尔本餐饮业纵火案破获等亦受关注。

- **美伊再开战**：美国发动新攻击，伊朗媒体称基什、格什姆等地爆炸，布伦特原油涨至85美元（[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/7/14/iran-war-live-us-launches-more-attacks-trump-orders-blockade-in-hormuz?traffic_source=rss)）。另据NPR，美伊争夺霍尔木兹海峡控制权，上月停火协议濒临破裂（[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/13/nx-s1-5891746/us-iran-strait-of-hormuz-updates)）。
- **西班牙山火惨剧**：英国游客Malcolm Timbrell在车内幸免，但其妻与友人跑向安全区时遇难（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cp9ld3p324jo)）。极端高温助长火势。
- **Sam Neill去世**：78岁演员逝世，新西兰总理与影星悼念，称其“英雄、传奇”（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy06e5e1lygo)）。
- **匈牙利总统被罢免**：议会投票解除总统Sulyok职务，他是欧尔班盟友，后者4月下台后政治清算延续（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cp8r002gdevo)）。

欧美的核心矛盾是战争与自然灾害，地缘风险与个人悲剧交织，气候议题与政治变局需持续跟踪。
欧美.en:
The Euro-American desk is dominated by escalating U.S.-Iran military actions, a major fire in Bangkok, and notable deaths. Domestic stories in Australia and the U.S. highlight AI regulation, arson arrests, and political transitions.

- **U.S.-Iran Conflict:** The U.S. launched new attacks on Iran after Trump announced a renewed blockade in the Strait of Hormuz. Oil prices surged to a one-month high near $85/barrel. The situation threatens to unravel the recent ceasefire ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c2ly580kxnko), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/13/nx-s1-5891746/us-iran-strait-of-hormuz-updates)).
- **Bangkok Bar Fire:** At least 28 killed, 25 critically injured. Witnesses described a devastating inferno with no way out, as a musician who survived was thrown from the bar by an explosion ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c24yev53q06o), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crr8gnx01d7o)).
- **Sam Neill Death:** The actor's sudden death at 78 prompted tributes from colleagues and politicians. George Miller shared memories of Neill as 'an exemplary human being' ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy06e5e1lygo), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/live/2026/jul/14/australia-news-live-nt-police-peter-falconio-anthony-albanese-ai-artificial-intelligence-copyright-antisemitism-royal-commission-bondi-universities-ntwnfb)).
- **Australia: AI Warning and Arson Arrest:** Labor MP Ed Husic stated tech firms cannot be trusted to self-regulate AI. Meanwhile, police arrested a man linked to a syndicate behind Melbourne's hospitality arson wars ([The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/live/2026/jul/14/australia-news-live-nt-police-peter-falconio-anthony-albanese-ai-artificial-intelligence-copyright-antisemitism-royal-commission-bondi-universities-ntwnfb), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/jul/14/melbourne-hospitality-hospo-wars-arrest-ntwnfb)).
- **Lindsey Graham's Sister Appointed:** South Carolina's governor chose the late senator's sister to serve the remainder of his term ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c05y3rlvp20o)).

The U.S.-Iran conflict remains the most consequential story, with direct impacts on global energy markets and regional security. The tragic fire in Bangkok and the death of Sam Neill also capture significant public attention.

日韩.zh:
日韩板块聚焦地缘安全、经济波动与社会事件。日本被指成为“间谍天堂”助俄罗斯战争机器，中国驻日使馆就南海仲裁案抗议；韩国三星、SK海力士杠杆ETF引发全球市场波动；日本大分县发生持刀袭击致4伤；现代汽车工会罢工3天。此外，一名中国异议人士乘小艇逃往韩国。

- **日本“间谍天堂”争议**：南华早报报道称日本存在漏洞，可能被利用为俄罗斯获取军事物资（[SCMP](https://news.google.)）。同日中国抗议日本南海言论。
- **三星SK海力士ETF搅动市场**：杠杆ETF放大波动，朝鲜日报报道其冲击全球股市（[朝鲜日报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxNTzZMZ05vdTdPVWpDUXoxM25JcGhHV1dxY05JUjBocjJtTjluWDdWWlBtUnFaSmdDTDdoMU1wYkFWdThsZ1ZyN2huNzJlV0V3RFZDOGpNZ0RfcGhYRVVGWkFWbGRzZ2Q1bGdJbllVdlBENlRGamxqT3c5TkpfRGcxRUVDemF0VnZmeUJVOFB3)）。
- **大分县持刀袭击**：一男子刺伤4人后被逮捕（[Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxNSFhkT2N1TlJXVmt4UTRUOEtpMFpKODRXeGJtLXFSekF2VUNRdkRXTFVoaDBsZFZxUlV4UEZoQTFxZS1RV3o4MHdKOVlKY3pOZzVFczl3ek13N3VVT3pyaG5scGJNdlltakJWY3podVBPcGw0aUI5YUV4bklFcFJfSkkxb0tvdTQ1ZEhiN3lScUw3QQ)）。
- **现代汽车罢工**：工会因薪资谈判破裂发动三天罢工，影响产量（[Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE4yY1JMUXoxM1lBSmhSdWxfck83ekszRzdWcnRESHExNkFkWnVmSFZjbkhzcnNLOUJVdzBuUGhGdmJ0NGg5VGQwVm96ZDZfTXNWSkdsd1VIUQ)）。

日韩板块凸显安全与经济双重压力，间谍指控与罢工预示供应链风险，需关注后续事态。
日韩.en:
The Japan-Korea desk features a knife attack in Japan, political and economic developments, and a Chinese dissident's escape to South Korea. Yen weakness and labor strikes also mark the period.

- **Japan Knife Attack:** A man was arrested after stabbing four people in Oita Prefecture. The incident is under investigation ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxNSFhkT2N1TlJXVmt4UTRUOEtpMFpKODRXeGJtLXFSekF2VUNRdkRXTFVoaDBsZFZxUlV4UEZoQTFxZS1RV3o4MHdKOVlKY3pOZzVFczl3ek13N3VVT3pyaG5scGJNdlltakJWY3podVBPcGw0aUI5YUV4bklFcFJfSkkxb0tvdTQ1ZEhiN3lScUw3QQ)).
- **Disaster Management Agency:** Japan's Upper House passed a bill to establish a dedicated disaster management agency, reflecting ongoing preparedness efforts ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxNRXo3VS1JdV9EMHZXaTFOQnFhdEhRVmM2dFlVSm45OTRzNkprSllQa0wxbWFHRDB0SE16LXo1V3dqbUZTVV8xeFZMdVR2blFPNDhiVlBCM1FITFR2UGoxX3ExMngyZmlxYWZTcFJGU2xVak96YUQ3dnRPeWh4ZjBsNGdNcTcwY3ZRb0lMSHJfSkNlU3BLWGRycHladw)).
- **Chinese Dissident Flees:** Dong Guangping, a Chinese dissident, fled to South Korea in a dinghy, highlighting ongoing tensions ([AsiaNews](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxPaWw0QWduRGhGMjI0bTlCVWN4SVQyVjNuM2FlaS12b1IzdUxObzlCbW9JT3V3OU9KMjJoTzczX0htTG9KcTlla3BmdTVaNTBhZ2FWY2lkTHpJRjY2anZHZ081YUMyTXNobnI0TEZrV1Vzbm9pTFIzMEpRZkFPdXJwd3duZmNhNjBmaG1TVUx1SktIMkVtbUtDYmY2MFRjN1V5ZFdR)).
- **Hyundai Motor Strike:** The union launched a three-day strike as pay talks stalled, affecting production ([Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE4yY1JMUXoxM1lBSmhSdWxfck83ekszRzdWcnRESHExNkFkWnVmSFZjbkhzcnNLOUJVdzBuUGhGdmJ0NGg5VGQwVm96ZDZfTXNWSkdsd1VIUQ)).
- **Yen Slides on Pension Doubts:** The yen weakened amid renewed Iran attacks and concerns over Japan's pension system ([Honolulu Star-Advertiser](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxOaEIybTNxdjFJdGRNR3VqbC1WaDBmYjd4Sng3aEZ5bGZCNVJtYkJaVDNvb1d5WG1pS0xIdDlPUWsxWVkxaFc2cWtNRFk0b0FFZF90dzZJMU9XM2llb1FUWGt2aXFaN1gtWXZyZ2tra0M2RGl3d0FpUDM4MU5wT19Pa1hYbWNod3hGMG5aTl82azI1VHlaMjgxN0RobTV6dUJHa1NyMjEtamFvZ2JvdEFlMDBUVVhwWjNEMUlfV2VRVFBGdnRI)).

Regional security and economic vulnerabilities are highlighted by the yen's slide and the Hyundai strike. The dissident's flight adds a geopolitical dimension to Japan-Korea relations.

中国.zh:
中国社会新闻以官方议程为主：习近平将出席AI全球治理大会，新华社连发评论强调AI服务全球福祉；教育领域集中报道校园安全立法、STEM教育改革、教育强国建设；此外，中国呼吁也门局势降级、推动与马来西亚医疗器械互认。总体基调积极，缺乏争议性事件。

- **AI全球治理大会**：习近平将出席开幕式并发表主旨讲话，国际社会期待中国注入动力（[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE53eHhuR2llS3FTS3JUSVd0cUY4b0xiVVFlN3VxMmdld3BQdXQxdkU3bVhIaUhvTEN0YUtKcERRODRDaExzQk9HRzFqU3NlSFRwb3BlbkZsYV9kV0F2NXd0MEYtWk5FMFRjMEdVSFRGY2pKQlhNU1ZjNjZ2UG82VzA)）。新华社评论称共同推动AI服务全球发展（[新华社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE0xc3N5RlREWGQzZHhPOV9laVlPeERMc0NiV3B6bXpfTGpqSHp3ZkxEWjVQM3dDVHZQN2YtTGlxbEdLYmhCQUpkUEtyUC0zUDJFd1pqNGJSMDZxWlpLYmdDY1JhMFpLTmVmTGlMdmFpbjluamI1dTEyVzlNTHY5QVE)）。
- **校园安全立法**：法治日报报道制定校园安全条例明确认定机制（[人大新闻网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE00TzRTdzlGdXQ5UHlFVTJLcEdwa1RiT3JNbmFyZGRhVUpMU1JCYlZKeXdnbmFpZWdhUkl5YktPLW16Y0ZUbnBhMV81dkRpSTNFajNDWFNvMnNIVDkw)）。近年来校园事件频发，立法提速。
- **AI时代为何翻字词典**：新华社发文探讨纸质工具书的不可替代性，呼应数字时代文化坚守（[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQMkZtMjFSbXZBZS1WMlN0WG1DSFlYNFh6eDFvdkx5QzI5UFVfTURXdGkyME1BVEFNMUZVemNsRjJHQ0xVMTVFOENSQzFocEVhNUhJM3cxRFMxTkNobVVWVzNHM1V4bFhqSmxBUUxTU3JqMldOUVpzZmxneEMtMk5CLWtycFJpT3dxWjBR)）。
- **中马医疗器械互认**：第二阶段启动，利好中国器械出海（[CIRS Group](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxQTWlvN1huU3F4Z1VteHFiNWl4ZFMxbkdWX1A5N2NYRXBBMklsNnM4d041NUdVR2MyYWNnOXlXMTlpWWN0LWgtNTdwWVAtTUtpWFJRVlpzNzlRWlk0S3dVTFpzMkxZa2NZT19tc0ZPY0dhbzZudEZ5TDN3WFY5b09sRGRpbmZkQTZ1eXBKRkFjWTNwbGJGZjA0V3hacFMtbFlQVFcxeHdLLXIxSVF3Q2RVWmJ5X0ZkRXZpRlBYby1vZ3JhdzFRamFlag)）。

中国社会新闻偏重政策宣导，AI大会是本周最大亮点，校园安全立法值得长期关注。
中国.en:
China's news focuses on President Xi's upcoming speech at the World AI Conference, educational reforms, and diplomatic calls for stability. Domestic policy initiatives and international cooperation are key themes.

- **Xi to Address World AI Conference:** International anticipation is high for President Xi Jinping's speech at the 2026 World AI Conference, expected to outline China's vision for global AI governance ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE53eHhuR2llS3FTS3JUSVd0cUY4b0xiVVFlN3VxMmdld3BQdXQxdkU3bVhIaUhvTEN0YUtKcERRODRDaExzQk9HRzFqU3NlSFRwb3BlbkZsYV9kV0F2NXd0MEYtWk5FMFRjMEdVSFRGY2pKQlhNU1ZjNjZ2UG82VzA), [Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE0xc3N5RlREWGQzZHhPOV9laVlPeERMc0NiV3B6bXpfTGpqSHp3ZkxEWjVQM3dDVHZQN2YtTGlxbEdLYmhCQUpkUEtyUC0zUDJFd1pqNGJSMDZxWlpLYmdDY1JhMFpLTmVmTGlMdmFpbjluamI1dTEyVzlNTHY5QVE)).
- **Education Reforms:** The state media highlights the importance of education in building a strong nation, with specific articles on campus safety regulations and STEM education reforms ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxPOHFDTmhCcHk4LXozOFVEWEtCSFpjb25KU1NtbTFpcmctREMxbE5aNEhQRFVvTXlxdXNReFo3RVhtaW85di1WWFVVNlhpWkp6VXJCREVJNW1GM3V5U0dvSzBDWmFSLXdIWWtlT0M4X254dlVWZVVEdDJnbEVhS25YWGw4RQ), [人大新闻网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE00TzRTdzlGdXQ5UHlFVTJLcEdwa1RiT3JNbmFyZGRhVUpMU1JCYlZKeXdnbmFpZWdhUkl5YktPLW16Y0ZUbnBhMV81dkRpSTNFajNDWFNvMnNIVDkw)).
- **China-Malaysia Medical Device Cooperation:** The second phase of a mutual recognition plan for medical devices was launched, signaling deeper healthcare trade ties ([CIRS Group](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxQTWlvN1huU3F4Z1VteHFiNWl4ZFMxbkdWX1A5N2NYRXBBMklsNnM4d041NUdVR2MyYWNnOXlXMTlpWWN0LWgtNTdwWVAtTUtpWFJRVlpzNzlRWlk0S3dVTFpzMkxZa2NZT19tc0ZPY0dhbzZudEZ5TDN3WFY5b09sRGRpbmZkQTZ1eXBKRkFjWTNwbGJGZjA0V3hacFMtbFlQVFcxeHdLLXIxSVF3Q2RVWmJ5X0ZkRXZpRlBYby1vZ3JhdzFRamFlag)).
- **Diplomatic Calls for Stability:** China urged parties to avoid escalation in Yemen and called for better natural resource governance in conflict-affected countries ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTFBOOGJpeHo3NDJYbHJKZVJ1blhlaHRVa2tMRWw3Rmdsbm1ic1Z2MHJib2JNeFZCNkR1dzVLbi1ZeVBUZTRnVHlDdkk5akFaWmVoUWViVE54X01GUzdzTk1TM0wwcXVjV0RIVkh6SUhlaFdpc1dNVV9oMjU1Rmc0enc), [Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE1Vb2tTeGZHVUNwdjRET19abHhxSENVYXgteVYyNGtlVWJseXhzN0k1QzdqQl9jQ0pkQUZJQ3VsQy1mU1A2Zm9jQzdJcVJMb2oxd1F6bUtFb1pQTUFOaDAwakdPYXp1Qmp6OTgyaDNYTTdGZXliU1JZTDNLNWpiQQ)).
- **Academics and Society:** A conference on constructing an autonomous knowledge system for area studies was held, reflecting ongoing intellectual discourse ([搜狐网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNbWpEcE9aVU9yM0VtSGtKbUpIQzVvcUl6WDl0VEpEUmRVSjZKX0pGSElNZjZzNFNpbTZZMjdRMW80VDBhLUhpXzZsNk5hbzFvU1FUVi0tbEcwRFkyUkxzQldfODBsWkR4NGhPSTJSMWdUZWdBRGZaSTEzV3htRnpNWnpIWm1BQWsx)).

China's focus on AI leadership and education reforms signals a strategic push for technological sovereignty. The medical device cooperation with Malaysia indicates expanding regional influence.

知乎社区动态.zh:
知乎社区动态呈现多元话题：付费知识、技术科普、影视娱乐与公共服务体验。贲德院士亲自讲述中国雷达突破技术封锁；“消失的人工客服”引发共情，讨论自动化对用户体验的损害；此外，《雀骨》主演阵容公布、阿根廷vs英格兰球迷遐想、知乎授出限制性股份单位等。

- **贲德院士讲雷达**：院士在知乎详述我国雷达从零到一打破西方封锁，内容硬核获高赞（[风闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE5wRWNBZG1yUlU0dENBQUhJMjY4akZ0b0hKVUJ5SHNHbng2dWRmYll1dXUwcWlQeWQyRThkM241eGhpTUdPcUVjWGxFLWhweHBUYk8zYmNveUFqM3c)）。
- **人工客服“消失”**：文章指用户遇事后找不到人工入口，呼吁企业保留人性化服务（[风闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE15NGdoM0Rjc0lsSHpReXo0QU5UZmJfNXJoSHNiOTJCSTZkT2ozMXhnMjR2TldhbWJ2cVNCRUE2NzBhRWlYYV9aSWNSY0w0cEh5dHpyYmtIeFVVNjVvdkp3RE5renIyS3BpMkNtSm1DaVAyN2ZF)）。
- **赚钱APP体验**：网易网列出5款赚钱软件，但需警惕陷阱（[手机网易网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1NampLWjNVM0tFRG9YZmNvSjZQODhOSWZibU1weDZMNm83dHgzOHpwZjlxRV95bzRsX3N1SktQR2JYMzFWY2ZaS19naHlWWVQzdEJOUFZUV3dXR25CU3NEXzNR)）。
- **知乎股权激励**：授出约222.67万份受限制股份单位，体现公司对团队绑定（[富途牛牛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxQRFJ6WG1GTTZlTFpYcFY1X3lnX00tZU1DaG1ZZ1ZhUHFoWUtqOVY2ckxCUGZ3ZFAwRVFMWGdXdlkzd3VzU21DeXE3ZXJYMFVpcFZZLXBIZGtmVEZ6ZFFnTEF6cU0zdDV2Z1Rsc3p3WmpmcHJvQkdSWEEyOTl2bXdRZ1RlTkpDa0lYbHo3THpZVTVaZHBpbHUzUg)）。

知乎热帖反映了用户对硬核知识、服务体验和商业模式的关注，人工客服话题尤其具有现实意义，建议平台改进服务流程。
知乎社区动态.en:
Community discussions on Zhihu cover a diverse range of topics, from practical earning apps to heartfelt tributes and intellectual debates. Several posts highlight societal concerns and niche interests.

- **Radar Technology Breakthrough:** Academician Ben De shared on Zhihu how China's radar industry broke Western technology封锁. The post garners attention for its insider perspective ([风闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE5wRWNBZG1yUlU0dENBQUhJMjY4akZ0b0hKVUJ5SHNHbng2dWRmYll1dXUwcWlQeWQyRThkM241eGhpTUdPcUVjWGxFLWhweHBUYk8zYmNveUFqM3c)).
- **Disappearance of Human Customer Service:** A popular post laments how complex customer service issues now require multiple calls, frustrating users who feel 'cornered' ([风闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE15NGdoM0Rjc0lsSHpReXo0QU5UZmJfNXJoSHNiOTJCSTZkT2ozMXhnMjR2TldhbWJ2cVNCRUE2NzBhRWlYYV9aSWNSY0w0cEh5dHpyYmtIeFVVNjVvdkp3RE5renIyS3BpMkNtSm1DaVAyN2ZF)).
- **Earning Apps List:** A post lists five money-making apps in 2026, reflecting ongoing interest in side hustles ([手机网易网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1NampLWjNVM0tFRG9YZmNvSjZQODhOSWZibU1weDZMNm83dHgzOHpwZjlxRV95bzRsX3N1SktQR2JYMzFWY2ZaS19naHlWWVQzdEJOUFZUV3dXR25CU3NEXzNR)).
- **TV Series 'Que Gu' Cast Announcement:** The cast of the new drama 'Que Gu' sparks discussion among fans ([新浪网](https://news.google.)).
- **Zhihu Stock Grants:** Zhihu (02390) granted approximately 2.23 million restricted shares, a corporate governance move ([富途牛牛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxQRFJ6WG1GTTZlTFpYcFY1X3lnX00tZU1DaG1ZZ1ZhUHFoWUtqOVY2ckxCUGZ3ZFAwRVFMWGdXdlkzd3VzU21DeXE3ZXJYMFVpcFZZLXBIZGtmVEZ6ZFFnTEF6cU0zdDV2Z1Rsc3p3WmpmcHJvQkdSWEEyOTl2bXdRZ1RlTkpDa0lYbHo3THpZVTVaZHBpbHUzUg)).

Zhihu remains a vibrant platform for both practical advice and deep dives into technology and society. The popularity of the customer service post suggests growing frustration with automated systems, while the radar story underscores pride in national tech achievements.

冲突局势.zh: 过去24小时，美伊战争全面升级。特朗普宣布**第三轮打击**并重启霍尔木兹海峡封锁，[美军首次动用自杀式无人艇攻击伊朗潜艇](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/13/video-3-lethal-u-s-drones-attack-iranian-sub-port-facility)，胡塞武装报复性[袭击沙特机场](https://news.google.)。马士基一度[恢复红海航运](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxOMF9yRXpoT0lIc01KamlJUmI0QnJva2p2RS0yNE9ndlZwcU4waDV5YjBpSEpRcjJxWXFHQ2l2RXEwdG5VcGw3bmY5N05tVFg3YXhpN19MUDBkVkI4QUtrcEVKeVZwWUtkTE9uRm01aXZIOTZPZ0FVXzF2dWxNYlpCNHh0SU9MLW9xaVBjS28zQUFhMVVtZ2p1MWlzVUxseE0)，但封锁重启后前景再度不明。联合国安理会就也门局势召开第10193次会议，欧洲外交官员亦紧急磋商。总体看，冲突已从空袭扩大到海上封锁和无人艇实战，规模与手段均突破此前红线。
冲突局势.en:
The US-Iran ceasefire collapsed after barely a month. The Trump administration announced a third night of strikes across the Gulf and reinstated a naval blockade of Iranian ports, effective July 14. Houthi forces responded by attacking an airport in Saudi Arabia, widening the theater.

- [US launches third night of strikes on Iran as Trump announces Hormuz blockade](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQTzk5TkVyaXI1Tl9tMUgxc20zOHBTTVk5M1NyX1lJd3MtYnFfVW9xV2dJR1p2Q1RVb3ZqRkRFRXBCM1N0VVdJTlRLT0R6Z0w0U1FLYlhfMXpFWGxFZ2htTmk1UGlmWEJ5THUwVzAwRWU4NUdxVnQzN2pUOENDbTVOekNfcld6R3RWN1h5US1vVkk1QzgtQUlhWXdaYnNvV3VyOFZuODJLcjAwbl94U2Y1cGN6VEJiM1BDTngwQXdoMzQ) — The Guardian reports the third round of strikes and Trump's announcement ending the 60-day ceasefire.
- [Yemeni Houthis attacked an airport in Saudi Arabia after strikes on Sanaa](https://news.google.) — Houthi retaliation expands the conflict to Saudi soil, threatening a broader regional war.
- [Maersk Resumes Red Sea Shipping Service via Suez Canal](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxOMF9yRXpoT0lIc01KamlJUmI0QnJva2p2RS0yNE9ndlZwcU4waDV5YjBpSEpRcjJxWXFHQ2l2RXEwdG5VcGw3bmY5N05tVFg3YXhpN19MUDBkVkI4QUtrcEVKeVZwWUtkTE9uRm01aXZIOTZPZ0FVXzF2dWxNYlpCNHh0SU9MLW9xaVBjS28zQUFhMVVtZ2p1MWlzVUxseE0) — The global shipping giant's decision to resume Red Sea sailings suggests commercial operators may test the blockade's enforceability, but this could be reversed quickly.
- [Security Council, 10193rd Meeting (PM) Yemen](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiTEFVX3lxTE96TEl1X0NiaE8yWDdRamhwbmVGNXJRcW10bWJicjkxcEQwaU94NHhUNnVWM0ZOXzZGaXkxUDRlWUNteVo0LTQ3bHFXbXY) — The UN Security Council met on Yemen as the Houthi dimension of the crisis deepens.

Bottom line: The Gulf is heading toward an open-ended conflict with no off-ramp, as both sides resume kinetic operations and the theater expands to include Saudi Arabia.

国际安全.zh: 乌克兰防空迎来重大突破：9国支持生产**Freyja反导系统**，目标一年内形成战斗力，[法国同时授权乌克兰本土制造Aster-30拦截弹](https://www.twz.com/land/ukraine-getting-license-to-build-aster-30-anti-missile-interceptors)，这是继美国开放“爱国者”许可后的又一关键步骤。俄罗斯[“纳希莫夫海军上将”号核动力巡洋舰](https://news.google.)在推迟27年、耗资50亿美元后重新入列，但分析认为其象征意义大于实战价值。法国阵风战斗机集成[廉价激光制导火箭用于反无人机](https://www.twz.com/air/rafale-fighter-adds-cheap-drone-killing-rocket-to-its-armory)，凸显各国对低成本无人机蜂群的应对焦虑。此外，[乌克兰首次通过无人艇将武装机器人送上俄控海岸](https://www.twz.com/sea/ukraine-lands-armed-robot-ashore-in-russian-held-territory-via-drone-boat)，预示两栖作战新形态。
国际安全.en:
Ballistic missile defense and unmanned systems dominated the security desk. Nine nations joined Ukraine to form an anti-ballistic coalition, while France licensed the production of Aster 30 interceptors in Ukraine. Meanwhile, the US military confirmed its first combat use of unmanned surface vessels against Iran.

- [9 nations back Ukraine’s Patriot alternative, Freyja — and want it flying in a year](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/07/14/9-nations-back-ukraines-patriot-alternative-freyja-and-want-it-flying-in-a-year/) — A nine-country coalition accelerates a Ukrainian-designed missile defense system to counter ballistic threats, signaling a shift away from sole reliance on US Patriots.
- [Ukraine Getting License To Build Aster 30 Anti-Missile Interceptors](https://www.twz.com/land/ukraine-getting-license-to-build-aster-30-anti-missile-interceptors) — France's approval for local production of Aster 30s is a major step in Ukraine's defense industrial base, following a similar US move for Patriot interceptors.
- [In a First, U.S. Forces Used Naval Drones in Combat Operations](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxOdHFUVUlaR2MzVHBhb3lDamRDbUtOT191WWZVc29CT1RVN2MwckNJanhlejhkcVIxbm1wQVlpeVlBZGhoT2ljcTM4S2VSZTI3VXBWS1dXWUxhZUdhcmhiN0h4ZGdJNlJFazNjTzUzN0RlUFJkZEt4Q3VlQ3RNdkN1eHNJQmZkYV9LLWJhXw) — The New York Times and CENTCOM confirm three Saronic Corsair USVs attacked an Iranian port and submarine, marking a new chapter in US naval warfare.
- [U.S. Navy expands Flight III destroyer fleet with SPY-6 radar built for missile defense](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPcEVWYU9QTXJjblJVR1pYVGpXaDRoN3JaWlduSXlNdEk5dHdmVVFCNnBLT05MR1NyaGtCdVRJalFEbDJQOFdUMThDLWlfR0hZZ2R4cF92Z0lJRndFYlN1Z3lnbzgxLVdFNEF2RjMtOGViRUJVLTNHbmNBbnBSVXhpMlBpWjNRRXhlZldpQQ) — The SPY-6 radar upgrade enhances the Navy's ability to track ballistic missiles in the Gulf and Pacific.
- [After 27 Years and $5 Billion, Russia's Giant Battlecruiser Is Back](https://news.google.) — The return of Russia's nuclear-powered cruiser *Nakhimov* (ex-*Admiral Lazarev*) is more a symbol of naval dysfunction than a capable threat, but it complicates NATO planning in the Atlantic.

Key takeaway: The battlefield is driving rapid innovation—unmanned surface vessels, licensed missile production, and new coalitions—that is reshaping deterrence concepts globally.

中国军情.zh: 南海仲裁案十周年之际，中国密集回应外部施压。[14个国家联合发表声明](https://news.google.)，要求中国遵守仲裁裁决，但中国官媒将其称为“废纸”，[《人民日报》发表钟声文章](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiTEFVX3lxTE5CR3QwczgweTBjVHBQRlhPODdMNVpYMjgwbTlVX0V3dzBnX2xqV2VQbW5EOWhCRGlvZEc3dnVCdzNyOERvaWFKWFljUlA)，强调南海不是“游猎园”。[香港举行南海安全圆桌对话并发布《南海仲裁案裁决新批驳》](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZEFVX3lxTE9aaXZpV19SX2RnR2lPRnRReDA5WHZuaDFDeFNZM1U0OUw3bEprbmZIUnJpZTZKUmJSeWQyalhEZ3RURFlNR2NpUV9XR1FPdHBycXNoU0hNUzlYVlhBaUxaSmdpLUo)，系统批驳裁决法理。同时，美国[将部分中企列入“中国军事企业清单”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag)，并限制美国国家科学基金会与受限实体合作，科技脱钩进一步加剧。整体上，中国在南海问题上显出“寸步不让”姿态，但外部压力也在上升。
中国军情.en:
Chinese state media and official outlets mounted a coordinated response to the tenth anniversary of the South China Sea arbitration ruling, framing it as an illegitimate document. Meanwhile, the US added Chinese firms to its military blacklist, and new restrictions on scientific cooperation were announced.

- [从东海到南海，中国对挑衅的回答只有四个字：坚决反制](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE10S2VzbFZSTXFGampraDNqTlhIRGphX3BqYW1ZeDRHSUtMdGtOaEdZVlR6Wmd1a3d5TlJPMkJ5Tl9NU2pnR0pWbnNTZlVWbzJEZ0FMRjJZRHBQUUhBZy1ZY3lkMVJRa3pleHhwZm14cHI) — Sina News reports Beijing's vow of 'resolute countermeasures' against provocations, linking the East China Sea and South China Sea as theaters of response.
- [南海仲裁十周年 14国联合发声](https://news.google.) — Deutsche Welle reports that 14 countries issued a joint statement supporting the 2016 ruling, drawing sharp rebuttals from Beijing.
- [美国将部分中企列入“中国军事企业清单”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag) — Cailianshe reports the US Department of Defense updated its list of Chinese military companies, a move that could trigger sanctions and supply chain disruptions.
- [美国国家科学基金会将实行新政策，禁止与受限实体合作](https://news.google.) — Voice of America reports the NSF will bar collaboration with certain entities, further decoupling US-China scientific research.

Implication: Beijing is using the arbitration anniversary to rally domestic and regional support against what it calls 'hegemonic' interference, while Washington's tech restrictions deepen the strategic rift.

海军与印太.zh: 霍尔木兹海峡封锁是今日焦点：[美国中央司令部宣布重启海军封锁](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/13/u-s-reinstates-naval-blockade-in-strait-of-hormuz)，[超过20艘舰艇已在区域就位](https://www.twz.com/sea/where-are-the-aircraft-carriers-july-13-2026)。[美军首次使用3艘Saronic Corsair无人艇攻击伊朗潜艇](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/centcom-saronic-corsair-usv-strike-iran-submarine-bandar-abbas/)，开创海战先例。美国海军陆战队计划在2027年测试[通用原子“Bullseye”巡航导弹](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/usmc-general-atomics-bullseye-missile-china/)，以增强对华威慑。海军授予TOTE公司22亿美元合同作为[中型登陆舰（LSM）建造管理方](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/13/navy-awards-tote-2-2b-to-serve-as-vessel-construction-manager-for-landing-ship-medium)，首批8艘。印太方向，[美海军陆战队第3濒海团在菲律宾北部训练](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/13/specialized-u-s-marine-corps-group-trains-to-defend-the-northern-philippines)，演练反舰导弹封锁关键水道。此外，美军潜艇部队司令提出追求“海底优势”，强调反制水下基础设施威胁。上述动向显示，美军正从无人化、分布式作战和海底战三个维度重塑海权。
海军与印太.en:
The US Navy is simultaneously fighting a hot war in the Gulf and positioning for future competition in the Indo-Pacific. The reinstated Hormuz blockade is backed by over 20 US warships, while the Marine Corps tests new capabilities for northern Philippines defense and seabed operations.

- [U.S. Reinstates Naval Blockade in Strait of Hormuz](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/13/u-s-reinstates-naval-blockade-in-strait-of-hormuz) — USNI News reports CENTCOM's announcement that the blockade resumes July 14, reversing a one-month ceasefire. Over 20 US Navy ships remain on station.
- [VIDEO: 3 Lethal U.S. Drones Attack Iranian Sub, Port Facility](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/13/video-3-lethal-u-s-drones-attack-iranian-sub-port-facility) — USNI News published footage of three Saronic Corsair USVs striking a Ghadir-class submarine at Bandar Abbas. This is the first combat use of expendable sea drones by the US.
- [USMC Eyes General Atomics’ Bullseye Cruise Missile to Counter China](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/usmc-general-atomics-bullseye-missile-china/) — The Senate Armed Services Committee included $40M for Marine Corps testing of the Bullseye cruise missile, a derivative of the LongShot design, as a long-range anti-ship weapon for the Pacific.
- [Specialized U.S. Marine Corps Group Trains to Defend the Northern Philippines](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/13/specialized-u-s-marine-corps-group-trains-to-defend-the-northern-philippines) — The 3rd Marine Littoral Regiment has been operating in the northern Philippines for three months, practicing anti-ship missile strikes and maritime domain awareness near the Luzon Strait.
- [US Navy Seeks ‘Seabed Superiority’ in Undersea Warfare Push](https://www.navalnews.com/event-news/cne-2026/2026/07/us-navy-seabed-superiority-undersea-warfare/) — The Commander, Submarine Force, outlined a new focus on offensive and defensive seabed operations, driven by threats to undersea cables and infrastructure.

Watch: The operational tempo in the Middle East is testing US naval readiness, but the real strategic competition remains in the Indo-Pacific, where new missiles and seabed tactics are being rushed to deployment.

科技产品.zh:
科技产品领域今日最重磅的消息是**OnePlus退出欧美市场**，[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/965084/oneplus-oppo-exit-us-europe)引用WinFuture报道，预计未来几天官宣，数月来的传闻终于落定。与此同时，**Sam Altman与马斯克就太空数据中心爆发口水战**，[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/13/sam-altmans-space-data-center-trash-talk-is-what-most-experts-already-believe/)指出多数专家认为短期内不现实。**微软正在测试无广告的Windows搜索**，[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/965090/microsoft-windows-11-search-menu-ads)报道称其移除了推荐内容和广告，试图修复用户信任。**Google Pixel 11的颜色泄露**显示可能推出热粉色、绿色等亮色选项，[Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2214292/please-let-this-hot-pink-pixel-11-leak-be-real/)表达了高度期待。**macOS 27 Golden Gate公测版发布**，[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/964701/apple-macos-27-golden-gate-public-beta-impressions-liquid-glass-siri-ai)认为全新的Liquid Glass UI是升级的主要理由。

**收束判断：** OnePlus的退出是国产手机全球化受挫的标志性事件；微软在Windows搜索上的“减法”值得欢迎；苹果和谷歌则在用色彩和UI细节吸引用户，产品差异化竞争进入微创新阶段。
科技产品.en:
Consumer electronics saw mixed signals: OnePlus is reportedly abandoning the US and European markets, while Google and Apple are refreshing their software and hardware with bolder colors and cleaner interfaces. The Verge, Ars Technica, and TechCrunch all covered the pullback, which could reshape the Android landscape. Meanwhile, video-generation startup PixVerse raised $439M at a $2B+ valuation, underscoring continued investor appetite for generative AI tools.

- **[OnePlus is reportedly bailing on the US](https://www.theverge.com/tech/965084/oneplus-oppo-exit-us-europe)** — The Verge reports the brand’s exit is imminent, ending months of speculation and leaving a gap in the value-priced flagship segment.
- **[SpaceX is gearing up for Starship's 13th test flight](https://arstechnica.com/space/2026/07/spacex-is-gearing-up-for-starships-13th-test-flight-later-this-week/)** — Higher pressure and new Starlink payloads will be tested, critical for iterative development.
- **[Video-generation startup PixVerse raises $439M, valuation soars past $2B](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/13/video-generation-startup-pixverse-raises-439m-valuation-soars-past-2b/)** — The company plans to expand its world model and global reach, signaling that AI video is far from a fad.
- **[Microsoft tests Windows Search without all the ads and fluff](https://www.theverge.com/tech/965090/microsoft-windows-11-search-menu-ads)** — A cleaner search menu appears in the Experimental channel as Microsoft tries to rebuild user trust.
- **[The Pixel colors might rule this year](https://www.theverge.com/tech/964972/google-pixel-11-colors-rumor)** — Deleted Amazon listings hint at hot pink, vibrant green, and midnight for the Pixel 11 lineup.

**Closing signal:** The OnePlus exit, if confirmed, will force carriers and retailers to pivot quickly; watch for Oppo’s own US plans or a revived brand like Realme to fill the void.

汽车.zh:
汽车板块今日焦点集中在**特斯拉的Robotaxi承诺**与**加州EV补贴倾斜**。特斯拉政策顾问在华盛顿听证会上表示正在得州制造一款轮椅可用的自动驾驶车辆，[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/13/tesla-wheelchair-accessible-robotaxi/)与[Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/tesla-says-its-building-a-wheelchair-accessible-robotaxi/)均报道但质疑其兑现能力。**加州SB 168法案签署**，为首次购车者提供3500美元即时补贴，但要求汽车制造商总部必须在加州，这意味着Rivian和Lucid受益最大，而特斯拉被排除在外，[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/13/california-ev-rebate-rivian-lucid-tesla/)分析这将对特斯拉造成压力。**日本开发出从废旧电池中回收90%锂的方法**，[Hacker News](https://tech.supercarblondie.com/japan-recovers-up-to-90-of-lithium-from-used-ev-batteries/)报道，这对电池供应链可持续性意义重大。**BYD发布全新超级跑车Denza Z**，马力超1500匹，价格低于保时捷911 Turbo S，[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/13/byds-ev-supercar-cheaper-faster-than-porsche-911-turbo-s/)在Goodwood FOS现场报道。

**收束判断：** 加州补贴政策暴露了州与州之间的利益博弈，特斯拉可能因此加强在得州的本地化；日本锂回收技术若能商业化，将改变电池回收格局；比亚迪通过高端车型证明其技术实力，不再仅靠低价竞争。
汽车.en:
The EV sector is a whirlwind of new models, battery breakthroughs, and subsidy battles. BYD and Lexus unveiled electric supercars at Goodwood, while California’s new rebate tilts the playing field toward Rivian and Lucid. On the battery front, Japan demonstrated a method to recover up to 90% of lithium from used packs, potentially reducing raw-material costs and environmental impact.

- **[BYD’s 1,500+ hp EV supercar is cheaper and faster than a Porsche 911 Turbo S](https://electrek.co/2026/07/13/byds-ev-supercar-cheaper-faster-than-porsche-911-turbo-s/)** — The Denza Z, priced near $200K, undercuts the Porsche on both cost and acceleration, signaling China’s push into high-performance luxury.
- **[Japan develops a method to recover up to 90% of lithium from used EV batteries](https://tech.supercarblondie.com/japan-recovers-up-to-90-of-lithium-from-used-ev-batteries/)** — This breakthrough, if scaled, could dramatically improve battery recycling economics and reduce mining dependency.
- **[California’s new $3,500 EV rebate favors Rivian and Lucid over Tesla](https://electrek.co/2026/07/13/california-ev-rebate-rivian-lucid-tesla/)** — The “MyFirstEV” program’s headquarters requirement hands a structural advantage to in-state automakers, potentially shifting sales mix.
- **[Tesla Semi adds another fleet as Paper Transport starts Chicago pilot](https://electrek.co/2026/07/13/paper-transport-tesla-semi-chicago-pilot/)** — A Wisconsin-based carrier with 87 million miles on natural gas is evaluating the electric Class 8 truck, expanding the Semi’s real-world footprint.
- **[Mercedes is now building its new electric C-Class in Hungary](https://electrek.co/2026/07/13/mercedes-is-now-building-its-new-electric-c-class-heres-where/)** — Production at Kecskemét marks a key step in Mercedes’ European EV ramp, ahead of a wave of electric models.

**Closing signal:** Keep an eye on how the California rebate reshapes Q3 sales—Tesla’s response, if any, could reignite subsidy policy debates.

AI.zh:
AI战场今天出现了两个明确信号：**大模型公司正在疯狂抢夺商业领袖**。Monzo联合创始人Tom Blomfield加入Anthropic，[Google News AI](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNZXVoTzE0ckpodS1TTXctRkVKQmZlZ1hqN1R0YTFSZGdtZktHcnd3MjRySEk4cGZpczBLQmVRM29XdVNEOHVFalBrRkh4YkcxYzJYd01NZnZTaFEzTExqWG5weDBKeVFsRGRienZ2SV9hRUhqdVJFYVpIUld5U05wSzhialVOYlNKM1FpUThwUUxzMXJiMVNPMWM4dkh2UQ)报道，同时Anthropic推出[Claude Science](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-science-ai-workbench)科学工作台，直接瞄准科研垂直场景。而**AI泡沫恐慌也在蔓延**：一篇[Hacker News热门文章](https://www.nationalmemo.com/ai-bubble-2677214150)警告不要救助AI领域的投机者，另一篇[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/13/already-rich-already-successful-why-the-last-wave-of-tech-winners-is-grinding-again/)分析称已成功的科技巨头因害怕错过AI而再次“996”。**AI对现实生活的侵入也在加剧**，佐治亚州一家庭因电力公司用地用于AI数据中心而被迫卖房，[CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/georgia-power-ai-data-centers-eminent-domain/)披露的案例引发社区愤怒。

**收束判断：** 人才争夺战说明基础模型仍是AI产业链最稀缺的环节；但社会对AI基础设施的抗议提醒我们技术落地不仅要算经济账，还要算社会账。
AI.en:
The AI industry is in a frenetic state: Anthropic poached a fintech visionary, Claude Science launched as a research workbench, and social backlash against data-center land grabs is mounting. Meanwhile, veteran tech founders are returning to the trenches, driven by FOMO around AI’s defining opportunity.

- **[Monzo Co-Founder Tom Blomfield Joins Anthropic as AI Talent War Intensifies](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNZXVoTzE0ckpodS1TTXctRkVKQmZlZ1hqN1R0YTFSZGdtZktHcnd3MjRySEk4cGZpczBLQmVRM29XdVNEOHVFalBrRkh4YkcxYzJYd01NZnZTaFEzTExqWG5weDBKeVFsRGRienZ2SV9hRUhqdVJFYVpIUld5U05wSzhialVOYlNKM1FpUThwUUxzMXJiMVNPMWM4dkh2UQ)** — The move underscores how AI companies are aggressively hiring from adjacent industries to drive product innovation.
- **[Claude Science, an AI workbench for scientists](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-science-ai-workbench)** — Anthropic’s new tool aims to accelerate research, competing directly with Google’s and OpenAI’s scientific platforms.
- **[Georgia family says they're forced to sell home to power AI data centers](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/georgia-power-ai-data-centers-eminent-domain/)** — A story that crystallizes the tension between AI infrastructure growth and community displacement; likely to influence local zoning and eminent-domain battles.
- **[Already rich, already successful, why the last wave of tech winners is grinding again](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/13/already-rich-already-successful-why-the-last-wave-of-tech-winners-is-grinding-again/)** — TechCrunch notes that veteran founders are returning to work cap in hand, driven by both ambition and fear of irrelevance.
