- **[World leaders, Nobel laureates, AI experts to gather at Vatican summit](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOMUlPUm1WOXFyRllxaEd3dkJlVFJPVS15T3IteWJGMTMyNG1UbllrQjI2Rlp1cHpfWHVDcDlJckFwUXRHVkpFVElfM21SWUZva0xMX243WlFIRTAwSl9RVVpTYlg5SVhGcGtGb1JILTNXbS1tT2h1djVyOVpHem9ONTQ4eHZJc3lHdVQwLU1MV1ljZWgwS0RWTmIyLVk1Nl9maFNtYVQ4MHdUeDBBSTdJY25FRWY)** — The Borgo Laudato si’ event highlights the growing intersection of ethics, governance, and AI development.

**Closing signal:** Watch for Anthropic’s hiring velocity post-Blonfield and any regulatory fallout from the Georgia eminent domain case—both could signal how the AI industry evolves its relationship with society.

HackNews社区动态.zh:
Hacker News社区今日讨论偏向基础与技术伦理。**《无线通信基础》免费教材**获得52点积分，[斯坦福大学](https://web.stanford.edu/~dntse/wireless_book.html)的经典资源重焕生机。**《递归自我改进的经济学》PDF论文**以33点上榜，[弹性研究院](https://elasticity.institute/rsi-paper.pdf)探讨了AI自我迭代的经济影响。**MorphoHDL——一种用于生长电路的最小化语言**获得34点，[GitHub页面](https://paradigms-of-intelligence.github.io/morpho/)展示了硬件描述语言的新思路。**一篇Amish语言的文章**（[The Dial](https://www.thedial.world/articles/news/amish-pennsylvania-dutch)）获得6点，反映了技术社区对另类生活方式的兴趣。此外，**卫星追踪器网站**（[Satellite Map](https://satellitemap.space/)）提供星链等3万颗卫星的实时位置，获得22点。

**收束判断：** 社区在AI热潮中仍保持着对基础科学和边缘文化的兴趣，这种多元性正是Hacker News的独特价值；递归自我改进的经济学论文值得深入关注，因为它触及了AGI风险的核心议题。
HackNews社区动态.en:
Hacker News front-page activity was eclectic, spanning wireless communication textbooks, satellite tracking maps, and a formal-verification tool for Arduino. The community also engaged with deeper discussions on the economics of recursive self-improvement and a critique of anthropomorphizing AI. These posts reflect a sustained interest in both foundational technical knowledge and the philosophical implications of AI.

- **[Fundamentals of Wireless Communication](https://web.stanford.edu/~dntse/wireless_book.html)** — A Stanford textbook by Tse and Viswanath remains a staple resource, now with renewed relevance given satellite and 5G/6G advances. (52 points)
- **[Satellite Tracker – Live Map of Starlink and 30k Satellites](https://satellitemap.space/)** — A real-time visualization tool that gained 22 points, useful for understanding orbital congestion and interference risks.
- **[The Economics of Recursive Self-Improvement [pdf]](https://elasticity.institute/rsi-paper.pdf)** — This paper (33 points) explores how AI systems that improve themselves could reshape economic growth and labor markets, a topic of intense debate.
- **[Is x86 ready to ACE it?](https://chipsandcheese.com/p/is-x86-ready-to-ace-it)** — A deep dive into new x86 instructions (24 points), relevant for developers optimizing for modern CPUs.
- **[MorphoHDL: A minimalistic language for growing circuits](https://paradigms-of-intelligence.github.io/morpho/)** — A novel HDL approach (34 points) that could lower the barrier to custom chip design.

**Closing signal:** The high engagement with technical foundations (wireless, chips, circuits) suggests the HN community is investing in deep skill-building—a countercurrent to the hype-driven narrative of AI-as-magic.

足球.zh:
世界杯半决赛进入24小时倒计时，四强各有喜忧。法国与西班牙的“技术流对决”被德尚称为“壮观”，而英格兰则需应对阿根廷的强硬挑战。转会市场同样热闹，曼联一天内搞定两笔交易，维拉截胡操作颇具侵略性。

- **英格兰团结牌与伤情博弈**：凯恩宣称球队“完全团结”，但赖斯的身体状况仍是X因素，[英格兰将做赖斯出场晚决定](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce8m996g9g1o)。
- **法国vs西班牙数据拆解**：Sky Sports分析西班牙如何利用亚马尔和罗德里限制姆巴佩，[如何将法国从夺冠热门拉下马](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13563068/france-vs-spain-world-cup-semi-final-preview-lamine-yamal-and-rodri-hold-keys-to-stopping-kylian-mbappes-les-bleus-storming-to-final)。
- **曼联连签桑托斯、蒂勒曼斯在望**：BBC确认4800万镑签桑托斯，另与维拉谈蒂勒曼斯，[曼联签桑托斯并接近蒂勒曼斯](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cn07dpgkj4eo)。
- **维拉6000万欧截胡曼赞比**：罗马诺“Here We Go”级别确认，维拉击败纽卡签下曼赞比，[HWG！罗马诺：维拉截胡纽卡签曼赞比](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE5MbG9hcC1HeE5jamctZGFYYUlDbFRJY3A1X0xNSlRNenpXQVdpNXJWckRHcWZWUVBlUGlpWUVnRUw3VkJoNG85LUdOVVUzb21HRjdkRGU0bw)。

转会窗开启背景下，英超中游球队的截胡策略正改变传统豪门垄断格局，维拉此举或影响纽卡下半赛季战力。
足球.en:
The World Cup semi-finals dominate football headlines, with France vs Spain and England vs Argentina set for Wednesday. England faces a fitness doubt over Declan Rice, while Manchester United have bolstered their midfield with Andrey Santos and are pursuing Youri Tielemans. Transfer activity continues across the Premier League and Scottish Premiership.

- **Deschamps promises 'spectacular' semi-final** as France meet Spain in Dallas. Spain's Rodri leads the pass count with 597, while Lamine Yamal and Mbappé top box touches ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c79y29l32gxo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [虎扑](https://news.google.)).
- **England's Kane insists squad unity** despite external noise; Rice's participation remains a late call ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c8924433kjyo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce8m996g9g1o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)).
- **Man Utd sign Santos (£48m) and close on Tielemans**; Aston Villa eye Estupinan; Inter target Spurs' Spence ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cn07dpgkj4eo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/live-blog/12040/13025489/tottenham-transfer-news-rumours-and-gossip-live-updates-and-latest-on-deals-signings-loans-and-contracts)).
- **Statistical comparison of final four** shows France most clinical, Spain least creative, England balanced ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cx2k9qj2nyvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)).

Transfer windows remain open until September – expect more moves as clubs reshape squads.

篮球.zh:
篮球圈今日消息偏少，但一则斯科拉转型新闻引发情怀讨论，国内则迎来暑期篮球培训热潮。此外，竞彩篮球直播渠道汇总吸引不少彩民关注。

- **斯科拉46岁成球队掌门人**：前阿根廷男篮名将斯科拉被任命为某球队掌门人，家庭幸福，与姚明同期球星如今走上管理岗，[姚明会羡慕吗？46岁斯科拉成球队掌门人](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPamJyQXdkdk9Kb2tLZGZnRFNXSEhBS2FkRzRTaTVGMDBxMTc2bmIyWHlGdkZYOXAwaU1QbXhTWXJ5NUhZQ2MxUWFENTB5dzlHQ3YzX2JCNVNhZjVici1MM0VkZUUtLXZUNzFZNDFIaFh1VWU5RWg3eDZJTUZ1YmFVeURvdTZqREdLdG56Ng)。
- **浙BA点燃暑期篮球热**：浙江篮球联赛带动培训市场持续升温，[浙BA点燃暑期篮球热](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTE5sTzBTUTJBV2NsblZZS2dXUm5MSHJxNWV0M1N1NDhfbFA4XzJ2NXRiUDVPTk9XV25MU0pSS0tmRkpTTFVNSEFmSk9iMXNxTk5HLXBoUVpMNmNkOTVVSVY5NXN3WDhoaVNPeDcxYWFNZWNEZWM)。
- **竞彩篮球直播渠道汇总**：免费看CBA渠道引关注，[竞彩篮球直播渠道全汇总](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNUjhIY09idWhPMUF1Wk14MXBtUFVobVhLMC1FSFhHaEstb0JrbTZxVlJDZUhBMWFfODhUVTVOOHlRNWV6azhDMnp3bVhQd1JBUU5CVWNMRWlBRWhZMEUxVFY0M1pEUEpGSlZSTzdYWFJ0WllKOTY4a0x4SDJSeUtUTWNn)。

斯科拉的角色转变标志着黄金一代退役后的新职业路径，国内篮球则进入暑期消费旺季，后续可关注CBA新赛季筹备动态。
篮球.en:
Chinese basketball news features a heartwarming story of 46-year-old Luis Scola becoming a club president, while grassroots tournaments like '浙BA' are fueling summer basketball fever. Additionally, a guide to live streaming CBA games on Douyin and Kuaishou has been published.

- **Scola's new role** as team leader and family dynasty builder – a story that prompts reflection on Yao Ming's post-retirement path ([搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPamJyQXdkdk9Kb2tLZGZnRFNXSEhBS2FkRzRTaTVGMDBxMTc2bmIyWHlGdkZYOXAwaU1QbXhTWXJ5NUhZQ2MxUWFENTB5dzlHQ3YzX2JCNVNhZjVici1MM0VkZUUtLXZUNzFZNDFIaFh1VWU5RWg3eDZJTUZ1YmFVeURvdTZqREdLdG56Ng)).
- **'浙BA' tournament** ignites summer basketball interest and drives training centre attendance ([lanews.com.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTE5sTzBTUTJBV2NsblZZS2dXUm5MSHJxNWV0M1N1NDhfbFA4XzJ2NXRiUDVPTk9XV25MU0pSS0tmRkpTTFVNSEFmSk9iMXNxTk5HLXBoUVpMNmNkOTVVSVY5NXN3WDhoaVNPeDcxYWFNZWNEZWM)).
- **Live streaming guide** for competitive basketball betting and CBA games on Chinese platforms ([Sina Sports](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNUjhIY09idWhPMUF1Wk14MXBtUFVobVhLMC1FSFhHaEstb0JrbTZxVlJDZUhBMWFfODhUVTVOOHlRNWV6azhDMnp3bVhQd1JBUU5CVWNMRWlBRWhZMEUxVFY0M1pEUEpGSlZSTzdYWFJ0WllKOTY4a0x4SDJSeUtUTWNn)).

With the CBA offseason ongoing, fans are keenly watching veteran transitions and grassroots development.

虎扑社区动态.zh:
虎扑今日热议集中在世界杯半决赛数据对比、NBA交易传闻以及电竞精彩对局。其中世界杯传球榜和禁区触球数据最吸睛，热火与克莱·汤普森的绯闻也引发大量讨论。

- **世界杯数据干货满满**：罗德里597次传球居首，西班牙三人进前三，[世界杯传球榜罗德里597次居首](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxQMmpmWUJJaWtCejBjZ2YzVmR3UGRzbzk3U2lYVXZkS3h2dENsNTlQckl4bnB5OGhGXzdnRnBSTGF4bkt2Zm0yenJQX1A0YkQ1TzBXbkI4a0xvN0Jlbm11U3pyRjFWZi14bmlUcnNFalBaQVVPdUlPTHpXZ3JHc0xoMWlpRW1RTG81bjVpcnlldlc1bjQ)；半决赛西班牙vs法国，亚马尔、奥亚萨瓦尔、姆巴佩禁区触球领先，[半决赛禁区触球](https://news.google.)。
- **NBA交易传闻**：美记爆料热火若追克莱，报价或含约维奇和选秀资产，[热火报价克莱](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFBEU01KUUtLVmVqT3RPeFVWQ29DeWNNR25GNkF5d1lPa2FhU0JBMGZCblVxRzM1X05jQXd1eE1aMmlLbmZydUdFdkhhV1pnMkdmaDh6Y1VB)；迈尔斯·布里奇斯将在太阳穿22号，[布里奇斯22号](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE1LVjNXREZXcThQN3kwQmJDdnd5MWhCZ3g0NXZsUEsyMDBjc2tlVzBOeU15eW1jano5WFVzUm9Qcnl2dTFQS281bUlkM1kxTFpkaDl2TkNn)。
- **电竞与足球花絮**：G2对阵T1，BrokenBlade获MVP，[BrokenBlade获MVP](https://news.google.)；阿尔特塔执教阿森纳期间转会盘点出炉，[阿尔特塔转会盘点](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxNR2d6N0g5bXlFci1IMTFoWTVrdkJqM3RZRzMtYmpHQVBLRUZmbWg1aDRFeWxLd2hZd0otb0pGMkVzN1NZekVYYUh3emNfTmZjNXJWeUdSR1p4Q3FSZm9QcFp2ZTRoN1dIMlo1YTQ2bXlrRGk4RmFNN0FKcUpBdWhQa2hKRVl0bzRHdEJkd2hDWkhzUQ)。

虎扑社区始终是体育迷的“数据与八卦首发站”，世界杯期间流量高峰，转会流言更是引爆回复。
虎扑社区动态.en:
Hupu's community is buzzing with World Cup stats, NBA trade rumours, and esports highlights. Key discussions include Spain's dominant passing, a potential Heat trade for Klay Thompson, and G2's victory over T1 in League of Legends. Transfer news also features Villa hijacking a €60m+ deal for Manzambi.

- **World Cup passing stats**: Rodri (597 passes) leads, with three Spaniards in the top three ([Sina Sports](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxQMmpmWUJJaWtCejBjZ2YzVmR3UGRzbzk3U2lYVXZkS3h2dENsNTlQckl4bnB5OGhGXzdnRnBSTGF4bkt2Zm0yenJQX1A0YkQ1TzBXbkI4a0xvN0Jlbm11U3pyRjFWZi14bmlUcnNFalBaQVVPdUlPTHpXZ3JHc0xoMWlpRW1RTG81bjVpcnlldlc1bjQ)).
- **NBA trade buzz**: Heat reportedly offering Nikola Jović and picks for Klay Thompson; Miles Bridges to wear No.22 in Phoenix ([腾讯](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFBEU01KUUtLVmVqT3RPeFVWQ29DeWNNR25GNkF5d1lPa2FhU0JBMGZCblVxRzM1X05jQXd1eE1aMmlLbmZydUdFdkhhV1pnMkdmaDh6Y1VB), [腾讯](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE1LVjNXREZXcThQN3kwQmJDdnd5MWhCZ3g0NXZsUEsyMDBjc2tlVzBOeU15eW1jano5WFVzUm9Qcnl2dTFQS281bUlkM1kxTFpkaDl2TkNn)).
- **Esports: BrokenBlade MVP** as G2 defeat T1 in LoL; LYON shares a Saint-themed meme for Faker ([MSN](https://news.google.), [MSN](https://news.google.)).
- **Villa hijack Manzambi deal** from Newcastle for over €60m, per Romano ([腾讯](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE5MbG9hcC1HeE5jamctZGFYYUlDbFRJY3A1X0xNSlRNenpXQVdpNXJWckRHcWZWUVBlUGlpWUVnRUw3VkJoNG85LUdOVVUzb21HRjdkRGU0bw)).
- **Bam Adebayo responds to criticism**, saying one-on-one plays were not his decision ([MSN](https://news.google.)).

虎扑 remains a hub for cross-sport and pop culture discussion, with NBA and esports drawing heavy engagement alongside football.

羽毛球.zh:
羽毛球新闻今天以建筑设计和国羽出征为主。光州羽毛球场和MVRDV设计的中国羽毛球训练中心入选画廊，而更值得关注的是国羽全主力出战日本公开赛，卫冕冠军石宇奇、刘圣书/谭宁将开启征程。

- **国羽全主力出征日本公开赛**：2026年日本羽毛球公开赛将于近日开打，中国队派出最强阵容，石宇奇领衔男单，刘圣书/谭宁力争卫冕女双，[2026日本公开赛前瞻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxOenlnQ1hRVEszOFRLd2hmcWljX0NUbGdKa3JXZ1I3UWZSUkx6LW12V2hqalpubWd5QUszSWlFZ2RBX1NzX2RQdzBUY21kd0ZlUzgzTTNwVnN0M2dXMjVMX2pqcUVRN3BWb1BjbGVZTzEtalFxWlpqbEtsR1pmN19odTFmejNfZGlBelNXX05PN1pTenFRai1lSzNFTzd5azRsS3ZPMHYya3c5MWZxRjdjSmR1Y2NvZDBkUjhVZGZMdGJ6eHFqS0IwYg)。
- **羽毛球训练中心设计竞赛获奖**：MVRDV赢得中国羽毛球训练中心设计竞赛，[MVRDV赢得设计竞赛](https://news.google.)。
- **光州羽毛球场建筑设计**：JHW IROJE architects&planners 等合作的光州羽毛球场入选画廊，[光州羽毛球场](https://news.google.)。

日本公开赛是国羽奥运积分关键战，卫冕压力下石宇奇和女双组合的表现将直接影响世界排名。
羽毛球.en:
China's badminton team has departed for the Japan Open with a full-strength squad, led by defending champions Shi Yuqi and women's doubles pair Liu Shengshu/Tan Ning. Meanwhile, architectural news highlights new venues: a badminton court in Gwangju and MVRDV's winning design for a Chinese training centre.

- **China sends full team to Japan Open** – Shi Yuqi and Liu/Tan aim to defend their titles starting soon ([Olympics.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxOenlnQ1hRVEszOFRLd2hmcWljX0NUbGdKa3JXZ1I3UWZSUkx6LW12V2hqalpubWd5QUszSWlFZ2RBX1NzX2RQdzBUY21kd0ZlUzgzTTNwVnN0M2dXMjVMX2pqcUVRN3BWb1BjbGVZTzEtalFxWlpqbEtsR1pmN19odTFmejNfZGlBelNXX05PN1pTenFRai1lSzNFTzd5azRsS3ZPMHYya3c5MWZxRjdjSmR1Y2NvZDBkUjhVZGZMdGJ6eHFqS0IwYg)).
- **MVRDV wins competition** to design a badminton training centre in China, showcasing innovative architecture ([ArchDaily](https://news.google.)).
- **Gwangju badminton court** designed by JHW IROJE & The Sa-ram Architects featured in a photo gallery ([ArchDaily](https://news.google.)).

Fans should watch for updates from the Japan Open, which will be a key indicator of China's form ahead of the Asian Games.

欧美.zh:
今日欧美娱乐新闻的核心是传媒资本博弈。Warner Bros. Discovery CEO David Zaslav再次套现约5947万美元股票，这是其三个月内的第二次大规模减持，叠加12州检察长申请临时限制令阻止其与Paramount合并，市场对交易前景的疑虑加深（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/paramount-warner-bros-merger-temporary-restraining-order-1236981542/)）。另一边，Paramount CEO David Ellison在同一日现身华盛顿，推动一项两党支持的联邦电影税收激励法案（[Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/paramount-david-ellison-federal-film-tax-incentive-1236810169/)），被解读为其巩固行业地位、对冲合并风险的政治布局。
- **James Franco外星人录像闹剧**：演员James Franco在TikTok持续发布神秘视频，声称拥有真实外星人接触证据，被媒体怀疑是营销噱头（[The Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/general-news/james-franco-alien-footage-tiktok-1236647261/)）。
- **迪士尼《Moana》真人版开画失利**：尽管有动画续集的巨大IP热度，真人版首周票房远低于预期，引发行业对迪士尼“翻拍流水线”策略的反思（[The Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/moana-disney-live-action-remake-box-office-dwayne-johnson-1236647014/)）。
- **卡通猫电影版被索尼抢购**：继“警笛头”之后，Trevor Henderson的另一个网络怪物“卡通猫”电影改编权被索尼TriStar影业拿下（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/tristar-pictures-trevor-henderson-cartoon-cat-1236981042/)），显示好莱坞对病毒式网络IP的追逐仍在升温。
- **艾美奖提名争议**：限定剧《Beast in Me》获得最佳原创主题音乐提名，但被质疑不符合资格标准，电视学院承认规则需收紧但未撤销提名（[The Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/beast-in-me-music-emmy-nom-questioned-tv-academy-response-1236646991/)）。

整体来看，资本层面的斗争远比内容创作更剧烈，David Zaslav的抛售和州政府的司法行动可能在未来一周内决定两大传媒巨头的命运。
欧美.en:
The US entertainment industry is gripped by a corporate drama: the proposed $110B Paramount-WBD merger faces an escalating legal battle as state attorneys general seek a temporary restraining order to pause the deal, potentially closing as soon as July 22. Meanwhile, WBD CEO David Zaslav is selling nearly $60M in stock, signaling his imminent exit. The week also saw the death of legendary Hong Kong producer Nansun Shi, a weak box office opening for Disney’s live-action *Moana*, and James Franco’s cryptic alien footage trolling.

- **[David Zaslav Selling $59.5M in WBD Shares](https://deadline.com/2026/07/david-zaslav-selling-warner-bros-discovery-stock-1236981468/)** and **[Variety report](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/david-zaslav-sells-59-million-warner-bros-discovery-stock-1236810050/)** – The CEO filed to sell 2.18 million shares; the sale comes as he prepares to depart the merged entity.
- **[State AGs Seek Temporary Restraining Order to Pause Merger](https://deadline.com/2026/07/paramount-warner-bros-merger-temporary-restraining-order-1236981542/)** – A 12-state antitrust lawsuit now includes an injunction request, warning the deal could close before EU review.
- **[Nansun Shi, ‘Infernal Affairs’ Producer, Dies at 75](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/nansun-shi-dead-infernal-affairs-producer-1236647162/)** – The film pioneer’s death is mourned across Hollywood and Asia; she mentored a generation of filmmakers.
- **[‘Moana’ Live-Action Box Office Flops](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/moana-disney-live-action-remake-box-office-dwayne-johnson-1236647014/)** – The Dwayne Johnson-starring remake underperformed, sparking debate over Disney’s live-action strategy.
- **[Jon Stewart Slams Trump Over Lindsey Graham Death Reaction](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/jon-stewart-donald-trump-reaction-lindsey-graham-daily-show-1236810256/)** – A political-cultural crossover as “The Daily Show” host takes aim at the president’s comments.

Keep an eye on the July 22 EU deadline for the WBD-Paramount deal; any delay or approval will reshape the industry.

日韩.zh:
日韩娱乐新闻今日聚焦偶像合约与剧集竞争。TWICE成员周子瑜被韩媒报道决定不与JYP娱乐续约，JYP仅简短回应，未确认或否认，但称其仍将参与团体活动（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854483wpp/tzuyu-reported-to-part-ways-with-jyp-jyp-briefly-comments-on-twices-contract-renewals)）。这一模糊表态加剧了粉丝的不安——若子瑜离开，TWICE完整体活动将面临变数。
- **新剧收视争夺战**：ENA月火剧《Dream to You》（黄寅烨主演）首播收视2.7%，与《明天见你》同时段竞争，后者保持稳定（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854453wpp/dream-to-you-joins-ratings-race-as-see-you-at-work-tomorrow-remains-steady)）。
- **宋康×李准英新剧海报公开**：tvN《四手两奏鸣曲》发布海报，以双人钢琴演奏为主题，展现青春成长与竞争（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854457wpp/song-kang-and-lee-jun-young-create-harmony-in-four-hands-two-sonatas-poster)），预计下周首播。
- **The Fact Music Awards公布首轮阵容**：包括ATEEZ、tripleS、KiiiKiii等，颁奖礼将于9月19日在釜山举行（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854446wpp/2026-the-fact-music-announces-first-lineup)）。
- **许南俊将举办首次粉丝见面会**：作为新生代演员，其粉丝会定于8月22日（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854375wpp/heo-nam-jun-announces-1st-ever-fan-meeting-heos-next)）。

TWICE的合约动向是日韩板块最大的不确定性，若子瑜确认不续约，将对K-pop第四代女团格局产生连锁影响。
日韩.en:
Korean entertainment is focused on TWICE’s future as Tzuyu reportedly prepares to leave JYP Entertainment after 11 years, though she may still participate in group activities. JYP briefly acknowledged the reports. Meanwhile, new K-dramas are premiering: tvN’s *Four Hands, Two Sonatas* and ENA’s *Dream to You* both launched, while Netflix released a preview of *The East Palace* starring Nam Joo Hyuk. IVE’s Jang Won Young also shared insights on handling public attention.

- **[Tzuyu Reported to Part Ways With JYP](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854483wpp/tzuyu-reported-to-part-ways-with-jyp-jyp-briefly-comments-on-twices-contract-renewals)** – The TWICE member is reportedly leaving the agency, with JYP only briefly commenting on the ongoing contract renewals.
- **[Song Kang and Lee Jun Young in ‘Four Hands, Two Sonatas’ Poster](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854457wpp/song-kang-and-lee-jun-young-create-harmony-in-four-hands-two-sonatas-poster)** – The upcoming tvN drama about piano duets releases a new poster ahead of its premiere.
- **[Nam Joo Hyuk Hunts Ghosts in ‘The East Palace’ Preview](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854358wpp/watch-nam-joo-hyuk-must-hunt-a-cursed-spirit-or-lose-his-life-in-the-east-palace)** – Netflix unveils first episode preview of the supernatural historical drama.
- **[Jang Won Young Talks Positive Mindset and Public Attention](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854227wpp/jang-won-young-talks-about-her-positive-mindset-public-attention-and-more)** – The IVE member reflects on fame and influence in a recent pictorial interview.
- **[‘Dream to You’ Premieres with 2.7% Ratings](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854453wpp/dream-to-you-joins-ratings-race-as-see-you-at-work-tomorrow-remains-steady)** – ENA’s new romantic comedy debuts modestly; competition with existing Tuesday dramas remains tight.

Next: TWICE’s contract renewal outcome will likely be the biggest K-pop story this month; any departure could alter the group’s dynamics.

中国.zh:
中国娱乐新闻今日以重大人物悼念和行业动向为主。香港著名电影制片人施南生去世，享年75岁。她是新艺城影业联合创始人，监制《无间道》（后被马丁·斯科塞斯翻拍为《无间道风云》），对华语电影黄金时代贡献巨大（[Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/nansun-shi-dead-infernal-affairs-producer-1236647162/) / [中国娱乐网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE9YRVBRaHFpRkpDZ0owX01DTEVwb3BhbmVQNnQtRUVmVGgtczBkb3JqNUxCTlRuTzNkTzZrbUc0dFlreFlRZXBXMnZSZW9OVGNJUkNuTkd5SFJacnM)）。
- **周星驰“功夫女足”选角引热议**：深度文章解析周星驰如何筛选新人，以及其背后的资本运作，提及“70万片酬拍出30亿票房”的历史对比（[网易](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9LR2Fra0k2Zl9QMVlyZk81MXlWWU45WGZ1a1ZjUFBRekdMSWFJX2g2cXI2QnEtQlNUMElYdE53YU1YZXpTRjBtcVRLUmRUVnRRRFdmVWhld1ZFcS1uQ0U0ZEF3)），显示周星驰仍属行业焦点。
- **李小冉被传11年婚变**：马来西亚媒体报道称其去年已低调离婚，但尚未得到当事人证实（[orientaldaily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE12dlhraWlwTmdpNTVfTTctUWhubzdhYmctN0VLV3ExS1IxMFZJOEE5RV9RY3d4d3Z6SF9iZlh5a1lPTlkxTWN4QVNWbHFPdFRZWUdZN1dseTc2QVQ2U3U5cGRZb2hLRVVzRWwySzFla3BwQmtpcUVRSQ)）。
- **行业观察：咖魔科技与华策影视战略合作**：双方宣布以科技赋能中国历史叙事，将AI等数字技术融入影视制作（[网易](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE11SXJSS0pDWEhlNHlaRjBjZUEwelJBel9hdVJObjJPLVJxbFdLY1hBNUpqc3dnY2h3RGotSGtoX3BKYndlSVlOYlZhRG1BeXF5MEh5czdCemo0VlZVVzZHRXdR)）。
- **“明星讨债，导演跑路”内幕爆料**：一篇独家报道揭露了剧组欠薪纠纷，但具体当事人未明（[inewsweek](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTE5KT3U3WkpQMXo1SkthbEhOS0NiOXZVbFhjaXRjZUVjbV9fak1KcFd5WDM5Mm1pUVpWX2NsYU5hZjNPcHN0TEZPS2ZyQ080TGRVLTlSbFIza0lpNVhfbGJR)）。

施南生的离去是华语电影界不可替代的损失，而周星驰与华谊的往事重提则折射出行业资本变迁的复杂图景。
中国.en:
Major developments in Chinese entertainment include the death of iconic producer Nansun Shi (reported under 欧美 but also in Chinese media), a strategic partnership between 咖魔科技 and 华策影视 to use technology for historical narratives, and a viral controversy around Stephen Chow’s past salary dispute with Huayi Brothers amid that company’s bankruptcy. Additionally, actor 肖战 is noted for breaking new popularity records in Korea, while screenwriter 汪海林’s comments on ‘demasculinization’ in Chinese entertainment spark debate.

- **[咖魔科技×华策影视 Strategic Cooperation](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE11SXJSS0pDWEhlNHlaRjBjZUEwelJBel9hdVJObjJPLVJxbFdLY1hBNUpqc3dnY2h3RGotSGtoX3BKYndlSVlOYlZhRG1BeXF5MEh5czdCemo0VlZVVzZHRXdR)** – The two companies aim to use AI and digital tools to enhance Chinese historical storytelling.
- **[Nansun Shi’s Death Confirmed by Chinese Media](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE9YRVBRaHFpRkpDZ0owX01DTEVwb3BhbmVQNnQtRUVmVGgtczBkb3JqNUxCTlRuTzNkTzZrbUc0dFlreFlRZXBXMnZSZW9OVGNJUkNuTkd5SFJacnM)** – Local outlets cover the passing of the Hong Kong cinema legend at 75.
- **[周星驰‘严选’ and 华谊 Bankruptcy Story](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE5ORld5RkhGSHdSNFJTcXdYNUk1eEZJUmM2V3UwZ2cxLWcxVVVlSExmYUwtTmliaHhGVmNITDJoYkxqdVlVbmZsMnJyUDNyMEFsMGMtdFZOSzRIMlYtOGY5VWZlZGZYZy1Qb3JPU1ZuZw)** – A viral article details how Stephen Chow took a 700,000 RMB fee for a film that grossed 3 billion, now contextualized by Huayi’s bankruptcy.
- **[肖战 Breaks New Floor in Korea](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE9QSi1RenAyTWM0Rm1GaDlxVEJKWnRwSXR1a2ZtZlF5OTRnODRMS0poTUZkQnFDQUtfa2FrajdUU0ZIc0RfeEtkdC1rSHZwR1kyTHVjQkdxSVAzaHUxOFROSmhDaG9LS2I5b0FwQm9wNno)** – At 34, Xiao Zhan is reported to have set new popularity records in the Korean entertainment sphere.

微博社区动态.zh:
微博社区今日热度极高，集中在两个话题：一是“瑞鹤娱乐”连续两天占据热搜第一，粉丝维权公开信要求公司回应艺人待遇问题，目前官方尚未给出正式回应（[新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1aUElVaGVLNTNOdkFSaHNjU2FLNk9sb3RUaTE5WEZNRmk5ZjNnZGF4ZWk3em5MT3FHUHRQWHRhSl96LVhmT2VXOG0tNmdVZEhKRDIxeDJoV1l0RmRrR0E4eHV1dw) / [新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxQdFR3Z0x3TktpZkpJSmNTaFM4UDlKMHhwNWMxcTNjSTF4U3J6elQ4UWZ3RjBDWlhmNnNnTUNwQmVxZFBJRnF4UklpSDdheUd2MkJncVJKaVhlQVI1aWZEelRiZ1BobkItaUM4M2RUa3dhOEVWd1FDVm9YOVV4YVlEU2dzVXlUSkhac1RmbDdDYzkxSFljemc4TWU3QndKUnhFM00tc3JjMUtrS3M)），舆论持续发酵。
- **苏新皓被三大公司争抢传闻**：有关时代峰峻、乐华、JYP曾向苏新皓发出邀约的消息在社区引发“抢人战”猜想，但均为未经证实的传闻（[新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE5JeWhENjdNX0FRRC1wZUZ4Q1cwN2RfZzJVQmhwa2RLa2VPRWE3UjdpSnRkWHJhX0g4eGRUVnNUZUNxLXpRT2RiLU1ERVFFd1AtM3pYNVR3czZ4QXQ4dUI0cWxydEtyS0lWZlh0bVVzS0Y) / [新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFB1RXdrRk5DT0VjT1hPRXlQcHpIcUFmT2prY09ENlBaWGItRHV0LXVUTGd5NHhSU0tISldNZ3F2SExsLXQ2RmZzV3AzV0RiWnRpbTRrc3ZHNG1BRl9rbXhOeTFLZ2xIXzdka2sxdDdjcWs)），但已成功吸粉无数。
- **关晓彤卸妆上热搜**：一则关晓彤卸妆视频被网友评价“卸掉灰尘”，实际上是对其素颜状态的肯定，话题登上热搜（[360娱乐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE1GeS02WlM1d0ZFSVBZQjNRaHJISElXeHp6RlBnT1p1T3RzeTlSTUxYc3NPNGRZeVZkcExYV3JTa2xHeHAzeWRYQmtPOVlDU2M)）。
- **其他热议**：关于“热搜话题如何火起来”的讨论也进入榜单，反映用户对微博算法与营销运作的反思（[新浪网](https://news.google.)）。

微博社区的情绪两极分化：一边是粉丝维权推动的舆论压力，另一边是偶像话题的娱乐化消费。瑞鹤娱乐事件若不妥善处理，可能演变为更大规模的信任危机。
微博社区动态.en:
Weibo is buzzing with two major threads: a talent war over trainee Su Xinhao, with rumors that three major agencies – Times Fengjun, Yuehua, and JYP – are competing for his signing; and a fan-led controversy surrounding agency 瑞鹤娱乐, which has been trending for two days after a fan group issued a rights-defense open letter. Separately, Guan Xiaotong’s makeup-free look went viral, dominating hot searches.

- **[Three Agencies Vying for Su Xinhao?](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE5JeWhENjdNX0FRRC1wZUZ4Q1cwN2RfZzJVQmhwa2RLa2VPRWE3UjdpSnRkWHJhX0g4ZGRUVnNUZUNxLXpRT2RiLU1ERVFFd1AtM3pYNVR3czZ4QXQ4dUI0cWxydEtyS0lWZlh0bVVzS0Y)** – Unconfirmed reports suggest Top, Yuehua, and JYP all extended offers to the young trainee; an agency war is heating up but no official confirmation.
- **[Su Xinhao and ‘Home Near TF’ Rumors](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE8zN2o2M0R6T25ZRkJybTAxN0FoY0ZzZnNjanFzS0VKMUxqM2YwTFJINWl0cGpLVDNEM1NPRDIxRFJ0d014R1o1WVNUZm1KeDFyV2ZKSi1kR2cyRkdwLWF5M1VqZlJPUXFPTk1qT0MydnQ)** – A popular narrative claims Su chose Times Fengjun because it was closer to home; netizens are debating the credibility.
- **[瑞鹤娱乐 Trending for Two Days Over Fan Rights Letter](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1aUElVaGVLNTNOdkFSaHNjU2FLNk9sb3RUaTE5WEZNRmk5ZjNnZGF4ZWk3em5MT3FHUHRQWHRhSl96LVhmT2VXOG0tNmdVZEhKRDIxeDJoV1l0RmRrR0E4eHV1dw)** – The agency has not publicly responded to a fan group’s open letter about alleged mismanagement, fueling ongoing outrage.
- **[Guan Xiaotong’s Makeup-Free Look Goes Viral](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE1GeS02WlM1d0ZFSVBZQjNRaHJISElXeHp6RlBnT1p1T3RzeTlSTUxYc3NPNGRZeVZkcExYV3JTa2xHeHAzeWRYQmtPOVlDU2M)** – A video of the actress removing her makeup sparked widespread admiration, with netizens calling it ‘dust removal.’
- **[How Did the Su Xinhao Topic Trend?](https://news.google.)** – A meta-analysis post examines the mechanics of how the topic gained traction, pointing to organized fan efforts.

Watch for: An official response from 瑞鹤娱乐 could defuse or escalate the fan conflict; the Su Xinhao story may be confirmed or denied by the involved agencies in the coming days.
